jobs.description:
**Job ID** 20214 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Compliance / Quality **Date posted** 09/25/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons it was recognized by U.S. News \& World Report’s ‘Best Hospitals’ Honor Roll for the eleventh consecutive year and tied \#1 in California \& Los Angeles. Cedars\-Sinai continues to be acknowledged as a world leader in patient care, education, and research.


Our 915\-bed nonprofit, acute, tertiary, teaching Level I trauma center hospital is in the heart of Los Angeles. The Pharmacy Department has over 500 team members who are dedicated on providing both inpatient and outpatient pharmacy services, ensuring that patients receive high\-quality care tailored to their needs.


This is a Monday \- Friday, onsite role.


Join Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center in advancing safe, effective, and patient\-centered diabetes care across the health system. As the Diabetes Stewardship Pharmacist, you will serve as a clinical and strategic pharmacy leader in advancing a comprehensive diabetes stewardship program within the medical center. Working closely with physicians, pharmacists, nurses, diabetes educators, informatics specialists, and other members of the interdisciplinary diabetes team, you will help reduce patient harm related to insulin administration, optimize institutional glucometric outcomes, and promote evidence\-based pharmacotherapy for hospitalized patients with diabetes.


In this collaborative role, you will help design and implement a real\-time surveillance tool embedded within the electronic health record to identify patients experiencing glycemic excursions, support timely care triage, and enhance delivery of individualized pharmacotherapeutic recommendations. You will provide clinical support to frontline pharmacy colleagues through patient\-specific medication reviews, therapy optimization, and management of complex inpatient diabetes cases. You will also help coordinate medication use evaluations, quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and outcomes reporting designed to improve glycemic management, medication safety, and patient care. Your contributions will help establish consistent, measurable, and evidence\-based diabetes care across Cedars\-Sinai while advancing the organization’s commitment to patient safety, clinical excellence, education, and innovation.


\#LI\-RD1


**Qualifications**
------------------


**Educational Requirements:**
=============================


* Pharm.D. degree from an accredited School of Pharmacy in the USA
* Completion of a PGY1 and/or PGY2 residency or equivalent practice experience

**License/Certification/Registration Requirements:**
====================================================


* Current pharmacist licensure in the State of California.
* BLS certification upon hire
* Board Certification in Pharmacotherapy (BCPS) or in specialty area is preferred

**What else are we looking for?**
=================================


* At least three years or equivalent experience as an inpatient pharmacist in a major medical center
* Has BC\-ADM (Board Certified \- Advanced Diabetes Management) certification, or ability to obtain within three years of hire
* Passionate about improving the safety, quality, and effectiveness of inpatient diabetes care, particularly insulin use and glycemic management
* Possesses good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex clinical, pharmacotherapeutic, and operational information clearly to diverse audiences
* Demonstrates strong clinical judgment and critical\-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate glycemic data and provide individualized, evidence\-based recommendations for complex hospitalized patients
* Has an interest in using electronic health record tools, data analytics, and real\-time surveillance to identify glycemic excursions and support timely clinical intervention
* Demonstrates a commitment to quality and process improvement, outcomes measurement, and translating evidence into sustainable clinical practice
* Exhibits excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to prioritize projects to meet goals

jobs.title: School Based Mentoring Program - Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Big Brothers Big Sisters of Greater Los Angeles (BBBSLA) empowers youth by establishing enduring, professionally supported mentorship relationships for those facing adversity. We collaborate with parents/guardians and volunteers to ensure every child in our programs reaches higher aspirations, gains confidence, builds better relationships, and achieves educational success. BBBSLA's track record proves that mentoring works, transforming lives one young person at a time

**Position Overview**


Reporting to the Senior Manager of Site\-Based Programs, the Program Specialist is a dual\-function role, responsible for program facilitation and enrollment/match support across BBBSLA's school site and workplace site mentoring programs. This position facilitates engaging group mentoring sessions, coordinates on\-site program operations, and builds strong relationships with school and corporate partners. The Program Specialist also supports the full participant lifecycle for Bigs and Littles, including information sessions, recruitment, interviews, assessments, application processing, mentoring pair matching, match introductions, ongoing match support, and match closure. The successful candidate will be flexible, highly organized, culturally responsive, comfortable working with youth and corporate professionals, and committed to child safety and high\-quality mentoring experiences.


*This is a part\-time position that also requires travel for face\-to\-face meetings with corporate and school partners.*

**ESSENTIAL JOB ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The essential job activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Program Facilitation**

* Facilitate structured, engaging, and culturally responsive group mentoring sessions at assigned school and workplace sites, serving youth, volunteer mentors, and partner representatives.
* Prepare, adapt, and deliver curriculum and activities related to academic success, college and career readiness, financial literacy, health and wellness, relationship development, and social\-emotional learning.
* Serve as the on\-site program lead by coordinating schedules, attendance, room setup, materials, technology, transportation\-related communication, and other program logistics.
* Establish and maintain positive working relationships with school administrators, teachers, corporate contacts, mentors, mentees, parents/guardians, and BBBSLA staff.
* Communicate regularly with school and corporate partners regarding program progress, participation, upcoming activities, concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Monitor participant engagement, group dynamics, mentoring relationships, and adherence to program expectations during sessions; respond promptly to concerns and elevate issues as appropriate.
* Use effective group management, active listening, reflective questioning, and conflict\-resolution strategies to create a safe and productive learning environment.
* Support the planning and facilitation of orientations, Match Days, special events, field trips, partner meetings, and end\-of\-year activities.
* Participate in curriculum development, program planning, and continuous improvement efforts for school\-site and workplace\-site programs.

 **EnrollmentMentoring Match Support**

* Conduct enrollment processes, including interviews with guardians, youth, and volunteers, delivering youth safety education, and facilitating intake procedures.
* Review enrollment information and assessments, providing recommendations for program participation based on collected data.
* Ensure accurate record\-keeping in accordance with BBBSA guidelines, database requirements, the Service Delivery Model, and BBBSLA Program Manual.
* Evaluate the specific needs of each match participant to support a positive youth development experience for the child and a fulfilling mentoring experience for the volunteer.
* Apply expertise in child safety and risk management when working with children, youth, and families exposed to trauma, poverty, or other adverse circumstances.
* Escalate child safety concerns to the Senior Manager and report issues to the LA County Department of Children and Family Services when necessary.
* Administer the Strength of Relationship (SOR) and Youth Outcome Survey (YOS) tools to evaluate the impact of matches on youth development, track Youth Outcome Development Program (YODP) goals, and facilitate the establishment of new goals as needed.

Description:
**JOB TITLE**: LGBTQ\+ Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Sr. Director of Community Programs

**SCHEDULE**: Monday\-Friday 9:00am\-5:30pm

**LOCATION**: Venice, CA, Access Center, On\-site

**STATUS:** Full\-Time, 40 hrs/wk, Non\-Exempt

**DRIVER POSITION**: Yes \[If yes, please reference driving policy]

**SALARY RANGE:** $26\.00\-$28\.85/hr

**ABOUT US:**


Safe Place for Youth (SPY) is the leading service provider for youth experiencing or at\-risk of homelessness in West Los Angeles. Founded in 2011, our agency offers trauma\-informed, low barrier programs that support young people in exiting the streets and achieving stability. Our robust continuum of care includes street outreach, drop\-in services, health and wellness programming, case management, education and employment services, and housing programs.


SPY is a unique social impact agency that values community collaboration, and a deep commitment to the wellbeing of youth. If you have the skills, passion, and collaborative spirit, join our growing team.

  



**ABOUT THE ROLE:**


Safe Place for Youth (SPY) is seeking a passionate LGBTQ Coordinator to lead a comprehensive LGBTQ\-affirming program that provides safe spaces, mentorship, education, and affirming resources for LGBTQ foster youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) across Los Angeles. This role will create engaging youth programming while building the capacity of staff, foster families, and partner providers through training, allyship development, and culturally responsive support for the 1,000 youth SPY serves annually.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Facilitate weekly Queer Joy group sessions (5–15 youth per session) focusing on identity exploration, self\-care, sexual health, and navigating internalized homophobia and transphobia.
* Integrate creative, youth\-centered activities such as zine\-making, queer trivia, playlist\-building, and DIY self\-care kits.
* Create a safe, affirming environment where LGBTQ youth can build confidence, belonging, and community.
* Distribute gender\-affirming products.
* Develop and maintain LGBTQ\-specific resource lists.
* Provide individualized referrals for gender\-affirming healthcare and legal services, including name/gender marker changes.
* Support SPY staff and partners in strengthening cultural competency and trauma\-informed practices in daily interactions with LGBTQ youth.
* Partner with LA Pride, Promote, and other local organizations to host youth\-centered events and outreach opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Los Angeles LGBT Center to provide mentorship opportunities for LGBTQ youth. Co\-host workshops with AMAAD Institute on topics such as coming out, intersectionality, and identity development.
* Advocate for LGBTQ\-inclusive organizational policies and practices within SPY and across partner systems.
* Collect data and feedback from participants to inform program improvements and broader advocacy efforts.
* Collaborate with SPY’s Access Center and Clinical Teams to support day\-to\-day program operations and youth engagement, ensuring LGBTQ\+ youth are connected across all service areas.
* Implement culturally responsive outreach strategies to engage LGBTQ\+ youth and allies in SPY’s case management and wellness services.
* Plan and facilitate site\-wide community\-building events (e.g. field trips, social gatherings, creative workshops) that foster belonging among LGBTQ youth and their peers, as part of SPY’s broader commitment to inclusive, affirming programming for all.
* Support wraparound resource navigation for LGBTQ\+ youth, including warm referrals for housing, mental health, benefits, education, parenting resources, and employment.
* Contribute to multidisciplinary care coordination by participating in case conferencing and team\-based service planning.
* Provide ongoing feedback to internal teams on how to improve site\-wide LGBTQ\+ inclusion and cultural responsiveness.
* Other duties as assigned to support the mission of the organization.


Requirements:
**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social science or related field **preferred.**
* Related work or lived experience will be strongly considered in place of or in addition to a degree.
* 1\-2 years of experience working with LGBTQ\+ individuals in a social services, education, community based, or related setting **required.**
* Demonstrated knowledge of LGBTQ\+ affirming practices, resources, and culturally responsive approaches to supporting LGBTQ\+ youth
* 1–2 years of experience providing direct services to high\-risk transitional\-age youth **required**.
* 1–2 years of experience utilizing a trauma\-informed care model required.
* Working knowledge of child and adolescent social, emotional, and cognitive development, and trauma\-informed care service models.
* Ability to work within legal and ethical guidelines when serving LGBTQ youth.
* Flexibility in scheduling based on program needs (including evenings and weekends for events/workshops).
* Commitment and passion for the mission, vision, values, and culture of SPY.
* A self\-starter who can drive innovative, affirming programming.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* A valid California driver’s license, auto insurance, and the ability to transport youth.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Drive.
* Deep cultural humility and commitment to LGBTQ equity.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Changes in the environment, such as the office or outdoors.
* Physical effort/lifting, such as sedentary\- up to 15\-20 pounds at times.

jobs.description:
**\*\*\*Candidates must be US Citizens or have valid work permits\*\*\***

Minimum 3 years as full fledged clinical research experience with both human subjects and use of investigational products.

**\*\*EXPERIENCE LOCATION IN THE UNITED STATES ONLY\*\*\*\***

**\*\*\*Candidates must be US Citizens or have valid work permits\*\*\* Must be in comfortable commuting distance\*\*\***

Join an established, collaborative clinical research team in Beverly Hills as an experienced Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC). In this role, you will help manage meaningful cardiology and cardiovascular studies that contribute to the development of new treatments and improved patient care.

This is an experienced\-level position, not an entry\-level opportunity. Candidates must have at least three years of hands\-on Clinical Research Coordinator experience in the United States, including direct work with human subjects and investigational products. Applicants should currently reside in the Los Angeles area and be able to commute reliably to Beverly Hills.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

You will play an important role in the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple clinical trials, supporting studies from start\-up through close\-out. Working closely with investigators, sponsors, CROs, participants, and office staff, you will help ensure that each study is conducted safely, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

Responsibilities include:

● Coordinate subject screening, enrollment, study visits, and follow\-up across multiple clinical trials

● Manage studies in accordance with protocols, GCP requirements, sponsor expectations, and applicable regulatory standards

● Maintain regulatory binders, essential documents, study logs, and research\-related certifications

● Serve as a primary liaison among sponsors, CROs, investigators, regulatory personnel, study subjects, and office staff

● Develop source documents and assist with study\-specific recruitment strategies

● Recruit, screen, consent, and coordinate research participants

● Perform accurate and timely data entry, data verification, query resolution, and quality\-control activities

● Maintain high standards of data integrity and regulatory compliance

● Collect, process, package, and coordinate shipment of biological specimens

● Dispense and/or administer investigational products as permitted by protocol and applicable requirements

● Maintain investigational product accountability and study documentation

● Assist with study budgets, invoicing, and related administrative responsibilities

● Prepare for and participate in sponsor monitoring visits, audits, and study close\-out activities

Required Qualifications

● Minimum of three years of full\-time Clinical Research Coordinator experience in the United States

● Demonstrated experience conducting clinical trials involving human subjects and investigational products

● Current residence in the Los Angeles area

● Ability to commute reliably to Beverly Hills

● Current GCP certification

● Strong knowledge of clinical trial operations, regulatory documentation, source documentation, and data management

● Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

● Ability to independently manage multiple studies and competing priorities

● Strong interpersonal and communication skills

● Excellent professional references

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world\-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad\-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry\-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations \& Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.


Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a creative, organized Social Media Coordinator to join our digital marketing team. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, you’ll work with the Organic Social and Catalog Brand teams to create and edit short\-form videos, turn film clips into social content, engage with fans, and support campaigns across Universal Pictures All\-Access social channels.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Social Media \& Content Creation*

* Monitor social media platforms and engage with the Universal Pictures At Home community by responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely and professional manner, and flag sensitive issues to the appropriate team.
* Pitch, produce, and edit short\-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, including in\-office shoots, and explain how ideas connect with the intended audience.
* Edit and repurpose film clips into shareable content optimized for each social platform.
* Support the Catalog Brand Team on holiday, anniversary, and other priority campaigns throughout the year.
* Track pop\-culture, social trends, emerging platforms, and new features to identify opportunities for relevant audience engagement.
* Curate, write, and distribute a weekly newsletter for the Home Entertainment team highlighting current digital marketing news and social media trends.
* Provide day\-to\-day support to the Organic Social Team to ensure smooth campaign execution, including building and updating presentation decks, highlighting campaign updates, performance results, and relevant trends.
* Manage all billing for the Organic Social Team, including vendor setup, invoice processing, purchase order creation and maintenance, payment tracking, and coordination with Finance to ensure accurate and timely payments.

*Influencer Marketing*

* Serve as the central day\-to\-day contact for influencer initiatives across New Release and Focus Features titles under the supervision of the Director, Digital Marketing.
* Maintain and expand the influencer database, keeping contact information, rates, audience insights, campaign history, and performance results current.
* Assist in identifying and recommending influencers based on campaign objectives, audience fit, and brand alignment.
* Support influencer outreach and campaign coordination, including availability, rates, deliverables, timelines, content approvals, and feedback, working with creators, their representatives, and agency partners.
* Develop campaign briefs ensuring alignment with approved campaign strategy and messaging.
* Compile social and influencer campaign results and recaps, identifying learnings and recommendations to improve future content and partnerships.

  

**Qualifications** **Basic Requirements**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in social media, digital marketing, video production, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience creating and editing short\-form video content for social media using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing or supporting social media platforms (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, X, Facebook, etc.).

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with pop culture and current and developing trends, with the ability to quickly spot opportunities and translate them into relevant content.
* Familiarity working with social media analytics tools (e.g. Sprouts Social, Hootsuite).
* Creative, proactive thinker who brings fresh ideas and follows through from concept to execution with the appropriate guidance.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate professionally with internal and external partners
* Collaborative and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership of day\-to\-day tasks while working under the Director’s guidance.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

**Additional Requirements**

**Hybrid:** This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in\-office requirements at any time.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Software Sales
jobs.description:
Description:

The Account Manager is primarily responsible for supporting Ansys software sales and expansion activities, from lead generation through opportunity close, into a set of assigned accounts within an assigned geographic territory. Also responsible for maximizing sales profitability, revenue growth and renewal success in their assigned Accounts. Responsibility within an Account could range from supporting established Existing Customers to developing New Account sites. Products and services are sold directly to end\-user customers, primarily via face\-to\-face engagements. The role will require collaboration with internal teammates and with our Ansys Partner team. Expectations for a successful Account Manager would typically include performing the duties and responsibilities outlined below.

**Work Location:** Remote Home Office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Perform sales activities for new and renewal business in assigned accounts and into an assigned geographic area to achieve or exceed assigned revenue objectives.
* Establish, develop and maintain “win\-win” business relationships with current and prospective customers to secure license renewals, generate new software business for PADT and ensure customer satisfaction. As a result, account plans for a select group of existing customers will highlight growth opportunities and tactics to be followed up on.
* Execute a regular schedule of contact with customers and prospects via phone, or face\-to\-face on\-site visits in travel throughout assigned territory.
* In collaboration with internal technical resources, identifies customer's problems, key business initiatives and creates clearly communicated ROI\-based proposals and quotes aligned to customer initiatives and business outcomes.
* Research and compile lists of prospective customers through sales leads, internet searches, periodicals, business directories, industry ads, trade shows, and other sources.
* Remain knowledgeable and abreast of PADT’s new, and existing products \& services to alert customers to improved capabilities, facilitating opportunity generation.
* Coordinate a variety of sales efforts with Sales Management, Accounting, Engineering Services and Marketing teams, to include supporting trade shows and conventions, plus schedule training and seminars to enhance new business opportunities.
* Frequent data updates into the PADT SFDC instance (and Ansys SFDC as required) to maintain sales records, accurately forecast sales revenues (New Business and Renewal) and prepare Territory and Account sales reports as requested.


Requirements:  

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or, bachelor’s degree with technical sales experience.
* Minimum of 1 year software license and/ or renewal sales experience with a proven track record of success.
* Military experience is welcomed.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated basic understanding of the industrial product development process, CAD, Design Analysis, PLM or Engineering Simulation marketspaces.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Professional written and oral communication skills. Visual presentation capabilities (including for executive level), organizational skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and grow customer relationships.
* Prior success growing company revenue.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of Simulation (Ansys) products/services, and software pricing practices is considered a plus.
* Track record of successful business transactions at industrial companies (Automotive, Aerospace \& Defense, and High Tech) is welcomed.
* 2 years of field sales experience is preferable.

*This role requires access to U.S. export\-controlled information. Therefore, for applicants who are not asylees, refugees, lawful permanent residents or U.S. Citizens (i.e., not a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\), otherwise known as a U.S. Person), final offers will be contingent on the ability to obtain authorization for access to U.S. export\-controlled information from the U.S. Government.*

jobs.title: Sea Logistics Operational Key Account Manager - Program Manager
jobs.description:
It's more than a job
  
  

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  

‎
  
  

Are you passionate about transforming supply chains, driving operational excellence, and building long\-term partnerships with global customers? Kuehne\+Nagel is looking for a Sea Logistics Operational Key Account Manager (Program Manager) to join our Operational Key Account Management team.
  
  

In this role, you will serve as the operational leader and trusted advisor for one of our strategic customers, ensuring the successful delivery of complex ocean freight and supply chain solutions across the Americas. You will act as the bridge between customer expectations and operational execution, leveraging data, technology, and process improvement initiatives to drive performance, strengthen customer satisfaction, and unlock long\-term supply chain value.
  
  

This is a highly visible role that requires a unique combination of operational expertise, program management capabilities, analytical thinking, and strong stakeholder management skills. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams across regions, influence senior stakeholders, and help shape the future of our customer's supply chain strategy.

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for strategic customer accounts, ensuring delivery against customer commitments and service expectations.
* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships while acting as a trusted advisor and escalation point for operational matters.

* Create, maintain, and optimize standard operating procedures, governance processes, and documentation standards.
* Facilitate business reviews and present operational performance, project updates, risks, and improvement opportunities to internal and external stakeholders.
* Identify operational risks proactively and coordinate mitigation plans across the Kuehne\+Nagel network.
* Promote automation, digitalization, and process standardization initiatives to improve overall supply chain effectiveness.
* Act as a strategic partner in developing long\-term supply chain value roadmaps and continuous improvement programs for the customer.


This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

* 5\+ years of experience in Sea Logistics, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain Management, Operational Key Account Management, Program Management, or Order Management environments.
* Strong understanding of ocean freight operations, global supply chains, transportation management, and customer fulfillment processes.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and leading customer\-facing operational reviews with senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to interpret operational data, manage KPIs, conduct root cause analysis, and drive measurable process improvements.
* Experience with Order Management, Control Tower, Supply Chain Visibility, TMS, ERP, or similar logistics technologies; experience with Nexus or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience within complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across all organizational levels.
* Strong analytical mindset combined with a proactive, solution\-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, customer\-centric environment.
* Experience supporting retail, consumer goods, footwear, apparel, or other high\-volume import supply chains is considered an advantage.


What's in it for you
  
  

At Kuehne\+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. jobs.title: Account Manager – Los Angeles (Hospital Sales)
jobs.description:
We are conducting a highly selective search for an **Account Manager (AM)** based in **Los Angeles** to drive adoption of life\-saving respiratory technology across the region. This is a **backfill** role, taking over an established territory and relationships.


This is not a traditional transactional sales role—it's a **clinical value\-based sales position**. You'll develop hospital relationships, expand ED utilization, and help scale a proven commercial model in one of the fastest\-growing segments of acute care.

**About the Opportunity**


Our client is a globally recognized innovator in **aerosol drug delivery technology**, trusted across ICUs, emergency departments, and respiratory care units in top hospitals worldwide.

* **Proven technology:** FDA\-cleared vibrating mesh platform that delivers medication more efficiently and deeply into the lungs.
* **Market momentum:** Recently secured a major Vizient contract, opening access across key IDNs.
* **Clinical impact:** Reduces length of stay, improves patient throughput, and delivers measurable cost savings.
* **Growth trajectory:** Expanding from 48 64 territories with consistent double\-digit growth and strong commercial presence across the U.S.


This is a high\-visibility role with **significant growth potential** as the company continues its rapid expansion.

**What You'll Do**

* **Develop and expand territory** across \~30 hospitals in your assigned West Coast region.
* **Drive ED adoption** by expanding utilization in underpenetrated emergency departments.
* **Build strategic relationships** with respiratory therapists, ED physicians, procurement teams, and hospital administrators.
* **Navigate complex hospital sales cycles** with a consultative, clinical value\-based approach.
* **Position solutions based on ROI** and hospital efficiency improvements, focusing on patient outcomes.
* **Leverage the Vizient contract** to accelerate growth and open new opportunities.
* **Balance time strategically** between developing existing accounts and opening new ones.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:** 2\+ years in medical device or hospital sales with a track record of success in acute care environments.
* **Clinical knowledge:** Respiratory Therapist (RRT) credential strongly preferred; ability to speak credibly to healthcare professionals.
* **Hunter mentality:** Self\-starter who can identify and develop new opportunities while expanding existing accounts.
* **Consultative approach:** Strong presence with clinicians and administrators; credible, persuasive, and solutions\-oriented.
* **Strategic execution:** Comfortable positioning solutions based on clinical outcomes, ROI, and operational efficiency.
* **Autonomy and accountability:** Thrives with ownership and operates with high integrity and consistent follow\-through.
* **Travel readiness:** Willing to travel extensively across your assigned territory.

**Why Join?**

* **Impact:** Drive adoption of clinically validated, life\-saving technology that improves patient outcomes.
* **Growth runway:** Join during a major regional expansion with clear advancement opportunities.
* **Stability meets scale:** Join a company with a 7\+ year track record of growth in the U.S., backed by strong clinical validation and market demand.
* **Culture:** High\-performance environment with supportive leadership that empowers ownership and strategic thinking.
* **Proven success:** Fisher Search Group has placed 60\+ reps with this client since 2017\.

**Compensation \& Perks**

* **Base:** $100K–$110K (stretch to $115K for RRTs with sales experience)
* **OTE:** $178K–$188K (top performers earning significantly more)
* **Ramp support:** 3\-month commission guarantee during onboarding
* **Perks:** Company vehicle, gas card, personal expense reimbursement, excellent benefits, and 401(k) match

**About Fisher Search Group**


This search is conducted in partnership with **Fisher Search Group (FSG)**, the only medical device sales recruitment firm built as a **vertically integrated talent ecosystem.**


We don't just place top performers—we support talent at **every stage of the journey**:

* Helping candidates break into medical sales.
* Guiding professionals as they grow their careers.
* Partnering with companies to build and scale world\-class sales teams.
* Showcasing stories and insights on the **FSG Leadership Podcast** (4,000\+ subscribers on YouTube since 2024\).
* Convening elite leaders in our exclusive **FSG Peer Groups**, where the best in medtech sales gather to share, learn, and lead.


Fisher Search Group is where the **Top 1% of medical device sales talent** connect, grow, and lead the industry forward.


Explore more here: **FSG Leadership Podcast**

In this role, you are both strategic and sales\-driven to manage and grow a portfolio of high\-value enterprise and hybrid accounts within the branded merchandise industry. This role requires a deep understanding of the promotional products space, strong enterprise\-level relationship management, and a proven ability to drive revenue growth through strategic planning, value\-driven selling, and cross\-functional collaboration.

* Own and exceed sales and margin goals across assigned accounts.

* Ensure client pre\-sale, order and approval processes, supplier compliance standards and production timeline expectations are met

* Accurately log and manage account activity in Salesforce to ensure full pipeline visibility and performance tracking.

* Successfully onboard new enterprise clients, ensuring a smooth and strategic launch.
* Coordinate and attend client events as needed, ensuring high satisfaction and brand alignment.
* Participation in departmental and other meetings as required
* Other duties as assigned by direct manager, sales leadership and/or executive team

* 5\+ years of experience in the branded merchandise/promotional products industry preferred.
* Proven track record of sales success and strategic account growth.
* Exceptional communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.

* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Employee Benefits Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding an Employee Benefits Account Manager to their team in Orange, CA.**


**Job Summary:**



The Employee Benefits Account Manager is responsible for supporting the growth, retention, and servicing of employee benefits clients through proactive relationship management, exceptional customer service, and collaboration with producers, carrier partners, and internal teams. This client\-facing role serves as a trusted resource to clients while supporting sales initiatives, renewal strategies, benefit program implementation, and ongoing account management activities.


**Essential Functions:**


* Retain and grow an assigned book of business by delivering exceptional service and supporting client satisfaction initiatives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, prospects, carrier partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary client contact, responding to inquiries and providing day\-to\-day account support.
* Support sales and business development efforts through prospect meetings, proposal preparation, cross\-selling opportunities, and onboarding activities.
* Coordinate and manage renewal activities, including gathering data, reviewing plan options, evaluating carrier proposals, and preparing client recommendations.
* Assist clients with benefit plan changes, employee communications, open enrollment support, and implementation activities.
* Educate clients regarding industry trends, legislative updates, compliance considerations, market conditions, and available insurance solutions.
* Develop and maintain service plans that align with client objectives and support long\-term retention.
* Partner with carrier representatives and internal teams to address service concerns, claims issues, enrollment challenges, and escalated client matters.
* Prepare stewardship reports, presentations, renewal reviews, and client\-facing materials.
* Ensure accurate documentation and maintenance of account information within agency systems.
* Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and applicable federal and California regulations.
* Participate in team meetings, training initiatives, and professional development opportunities.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.


**Competencies \& Qualifications:**


* Minimum of 5 years of employee benefits account management experience.
* Active California Life, Accident \& Health Insurance License in good standing.
* Professional designation such as CEBS, RHU, REBC, GBA, or other industry\-related certification preferred.
* Strong knowledge of employee benefits products, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and voluntary benefits.
* Strong understanding of employee benefits compliance requirements and group\-size regulations including applicable state and federal laws.
* Experience supporting employee benefits sales, account management, renewals, and client service functions.
* Excellent relationship\-building and customer service skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present information professionally to clients and prospects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Prior experience with Epic, Sales Force, Ease, Employee Navigator and Wood \& Brown is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
* Knowledge of employee benefits regulations and compliance requirements.

 **Disclaimer:**



While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.


**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**



FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.


**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health\-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays \& 2 floating holidays!

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/
  
  

Medical Diagnostic Laboratories is a member of Genesis Global Group, an equal opportunity employer.

The Global Institute of Logistics has named B\&H Worldwide as the worlds Best in Class Global Aerospace Logistics Company. As the benchmark independent freight forwarder in the global aerospace logistics space, our vision is to be the most respected, valued, passionate and entrusted leader in global aerospace logistics. We aim to provide our employees with a rewarding, safe and empowered environment that fosters high standards. Working at B\&H Worldwide you will have the opportunity to grow your career supported by an award\-winning team and industry


**Our Mission**


To support our customers with consistent, dependable, competitive and innovative logistics solutions which powers their business.


**Our Vision**


To be the most respected, valued, passionate and entrusted leader in global aerospace logistics.


Where to find more information about us: https://bhworldwide.com/


**The Opportunity**


Responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers within the US region, driving sales growth by identifying new business opportunities within key accounts, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure Best\-in\-Class customer satisfaction; essentially acting as the primary point of contact for key accounts within assigned region.


The role involves overseeing and managing operational performance delivery for assigned strategic customers to ensure that service expectations are managed in line with KPIs and the customers expectations. This includes airlines, MROs (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul providers), aircraft leasing companies, OEMs and aviation suppliers. The role focuses on ensuring seamless logistics solutions for time\-critical aircraft parts, AOG (Aircraft on Ground) situations, and routine supply chain movements while driving revenue growth and customer retention.


If you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment where precision, responsiveness, and commercial thinking matter, this role offers significant autonomy and visibility.


**Location:** Miami or Los Angeles

**Working Pattern:** Full Time (Monday to Friday)


**Key Role Accountabilities:**


* Manage and develop relationships with strategic aviation clients including airlines, MROs, OEMs, leasing companies, and freight partners
* Act as the primary commercial and operational point of contact for customer logistics requirements, including urgent AOG shipments
* Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with customer operational and commercial objectives
* Coordinate closely with Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of time\-critical aircraft part movements
* Monitor shipment performance, service levels, and compliance with aviation regulations.
* Identify opportunities for service expansion including warehousing, charter solutions, customs brokerage, and long\-term contract agreements
* Negotiate pricing structures, service agreements, and contract renewals to protect margin and drive revenue growth
* Ensure compliance with aviation security regulations (e.g., known consignor requirements, dangerous goods handling, customs regulations).
* Prepare regular account performance reports, including KPIs and service reviews.
* Manage service escalations swiftly to minimize operational disruption and protect customer relationships
* Maintain awareness of global aviation trends, regulatory developments, and supply chain challenges

**The Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for this role will be measured by:**


* Revenue growth and margin performance across assigned accounts
* Customer retention and contract renewals
* On\-time delivery performance, particularly for AOG shipments
* Customer satisfaction and service level adherence
* Responsiveness to urgent aviation logistics requests

  

**Your Experience**


We are looking for a customer\-focused professional with:


* Strong understanding of aviation logistics and time\-critical freight operation
* Solid knowledge of AOG (Aircraft on Ground) processes and aircraft spare parts handling
* Experience managing airline, MRO, or aerospace manufacturer accounts
* Comprehensive knowledge of the aerospace industry
* Strong knowledge of freight forwarding processes, including regional variations
* Supervisory\-level experience or above in logistics or account management
* Excellent negotiation skills and strong commercial acumen
* Ability to operate effectively in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain customer relationships
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and regulatory awareness
* Proficiency in CRM systems and logistics management platforms
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset
* Willingness to travel as required


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Bachelors degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (preferred)
* 3\-7\+ years experience in aviation logistics, freight forwarding, or aerospace supply chain management
* Proven track record of revenue growth, account retention, and margin management
* Strong knowledge of international shipping, customs procedures, and dangerous goods regulations

* Employee Assistance Programme.
* Free on\-site parking.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Location: Orange County, CA


Territory Sales Representative at Benco Dental


At Benco Dental, our company is our family, and we are looking for a new addition to assist us in Driving Dentistry Forward. Please review the description below carefully to ensure that this position is the perfect match for you!


**What’s in it for YOU?**


* Excellent Compensation Packages
* Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits Effective on Day 1
* 401k Package and Profit Sharing
* Associate Discounts and Community Giveback Programs
* College Tuition Savings Program
* Caring Family Culture Toward all Associates
* Certified as a FORTUNE Great Place to Work
* Opportunities to Build a Better Benco through Diversity and Inclusion Resource Groups
* Family owned for 90\+ years

**Position Summary:**

As the **Benco Territory Sales Representative,** youwill drive sales of merchandise, equipment, technology, and Benco services; solicit new business through personal efforts and referrals; maximize the customer experience; enhance selling skills in product and services focus areas; develop healthy/productive working relationships with customers, vendors and Benco teammates. Your role as the Territory Sales Representative is essential in ensuring all transactions are successful and pleasant for all.


**Do YOU Possess These Skills and Attributes?**


* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to independently stay focused and motivated
* Exceptional time management, organizational, and customer service skills
* Proficient computer skills

**Do These Responsibilities Interest YOU?**


* Travel and make regular face\-to\-face sales calls to maintain customer relationships and sales business; lead sales activities with assigned customers; develop strategies, provide information, and answer questions support business goals and sales growth
* Prospect to drive profitable growth and achieve sales goals; add new buying accounts and develop new customer relationships; identify new business through a variety of methods including cold calling and networking
* Lead sales activities with assigned customers and partner with them to build long\-term relationships; Co\-travel with equipment specialists and vendors to uncover opportunities; conduct TRA presentations; Develop a plan to achieve personal \& regional goals for company\-wide promotions
* Partner regularly with vendor reps to continue to learn and gain knowledge about new products. Participate in all sales meetings, dental conventions, team building events and sales training as required
* Identify business needs of clients and leverage Benco’s offering to assist them with a customer\-first mantra
* Develop an in\-depth understanding of our dental products and services in order to provide accurate and detailed information to customers
* Stay updated on dental industry trends, market dynamics, and product and service offerings
* Communicate effectively with regional teammates (equipment sales, service, and inside support) to achieve customer goals and solve customer or internal issues
* Utilize technology and data tools for effective sales calls, opportunities, activity, presentations, publications, and efficient scheduling/follow\-up
* Participate in all sales meetings, dental conventions, team building events and sales training as required
* Identify business needs of clients, and leverage Benco’s offering to assist them with a customer\-first mantra
* Engage in continuous education and learning to become well versed on Benco’s product offering and up to date on the dental industry


**Do YOU Meet These Requirements?**


* Minimum of 2 years of successful sales experience.
* Possess a dependable vehicle, valid driver’s license, and an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to travel in assigned territory daily, as required for customers, vendors and Benco teammates, business and group meetings, and Customer Experience Trips as well as limited overnight travel

Entry level Territory Sales Reps can expect a minimum annualized compensation plan of $75k/year \+ monthly allowance. Our commission structure is unlimited, the more you sell, the more you make (less your draw)!


**Who We Are: It’s our Mission to Drive Dentistry Forward**


Benco Dental, the largest privately owned, full\-service dental distributor in the United States, has remained in the family since 1930—a family that now includes our more than 40,000 customers and over 1,500 associates in the 48 contiguous states.


We provide more supply and equipment options than any other full\-service distributor, an offering enhanced by a comprehensive suite of services, including office design, equipment repair, practice coaching, financing and project management, wealth management and dental\-specific technology solutions. These services are supported by over 400 professionally trained sales representatives and 300 factory\-trained service technicians who begin every task by asking “What does the customer want?”


If you enjoy working for a progressive company, who is committed to diversity in our workforce, who values all customers and associates, who also provides the opportunity for growth and development\- we encourage you to learn more about our Benco family. We are looking for driven professionals who want to play a key role in our future success, while making a positive impact within our industry. Thank you for your interest in Benco Dental. We look forward to hearing from you!


We're proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. At Benco Dental we celebrate our associates' differences to foster a culture of diversity and inclusion every day. Click here to learn more about how we promote Equal Opportunity and Diversity and Inclusion at Benco.


* This position is a field\-based / territory\-based / virtually\- based / remote\-based position that does not require consistently reporting to a physical Benco location.

jobs.title: Edge Cyber Security Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**We Are:**

  

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. Technology is at the core of change today, and Accenture brings broad capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and a commitment to delivering outcomes that matter.

  

Accenture Edge is Accenture’s purpose\-built business serving high\-growth mid\-market organizations with annual revenues between **$300 million and $3 billion**. Leveraging the power of AI, data, cloud, and Accenture’s deep industry expertise, Edge helps clients accelerate digital transformation, drive operational excellence, and achieve measurable business outcomes through innovative, scalable, and right\-sized solutions tailored to their growth ambitions. By combining industry\-leading talent, proven methodologies, and strategic ecosystem partnerships, Accenture Edge enables organizations to reinvent how they operate, enhance customer experiences, and create sustainable value in an increasingly AI\-driven world.

 **To learn more about Accenture Edge, visit:** Accenture Edge \| Built for Your Scale

 **The Work:**

  

As an Inside Sales Representative, you will support the end\-to\-end sales process for standardized cyber security solutions for mid\-market clients in the United States, from initial needs assessment through deal closure. You will collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to support a smooth transition to delivery and client onboarding.


This is a digital\-first sales role. You will identify and progress opportunities through digital and social channels, including LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, AI and generative AI tools. You will also coordinate with marketing teams to develop points of view, support multi\-client campaigns and maintain a disciplined commercial pipeline.

* **Drive digital sales and opportunity identification:** Identify and progress cyber security sales opportunities through digital and social channels, building a consistent pipeline of standardized solution opportunities across the U.S. mid\-market.
* **Support end\-to\-end sales of standardized solutions:** Own the sales process for straightforward, well\-defined cyber security solutions, from initial needs assessment and solution positioning through commercial negotiation and deal closure.
* **Coordinate across marketing channels:** Partner with marketing and campaign teams to create and share cyber security points of view, execute multi\-client outreach and deliver consistent messaging to U.S. mid\-market audiences.
* **Create client\-facing content:** Support the development of insight\-led points of view, campaign content and client\-facing collateral in partnership with cyber security subject matter experts and marketing teams.
* **Manage client contacts and communications:** Maintain accurate records of client contacts, interaction history and pipeline status in Salesforce or an equivalent CRM, while ensuring timely and professional communications throughout the sales cycle.
* **Leverage AI and generative AI:** Use AI\-enabled tools to source opportunities, personalize outreach, accelerate research and progress opportunities efficiently.
* **Enable a smooth transition to delivery:** Collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to ensure a well\-documented handoff from sale to onboarding.
* **Maintain pipeline accuracy and reporting:** Own the accuracy of pipeline data, contact records and sales activity logs. Provide clear reporting on pipeline status, campaign performance and conversion metrics.

 **What’s In It for You**:

  

* Contribute to a high\-growth cyber security initiative focused on the U.S. mid\-market.
* Work at the intersection of sales, marketing and technology while building skills in digital selling, campaign management and cyber security commercialization.

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. We're excited about what's next, and we're looking for others to join us on our journey.

The **Customer Success Manager** role will play a critical part in the exciting growth trajectory of Tines. As an automation platform, the more the customer automates, the more value they see. Your role will be to drive adoption and expand the usage across the customer base, ensuring that our customers realize the full potential of the platform. Alongside expansion with existing teams, you will play a crucial part in our strategy to expand outside of security teams into other functions in our clients (IT, Engineering, Operations).



You will do this by supporting our customers from onboarding to ongoing support to expansion and renewals. You will become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Tines product, helping foster champions within the customer who will identify automation opportunities across their organization. At the same time, you will provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, helping us shape the future of the product. The role will also partner closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other internal teams.


**What you will be doing:**


* Leading a first\-class onboarding experience and ensuring customer use cases and requirements are met in the specified timeline
* Translating technical customer needs to internal technical teams and delivering feedback to the Product team on new feature requests and enhancements to shape and improve the platform
* Coordinating onboarding and business reviews to evaluate performance, learn about the customers priorities, and locate new opportunities to promote expansion within existing and new teams
* Partnering with internal resources to build account plans and align customer needs with use cases to increase platform usage

* Knowledge of API's \+ how they function

Our next opportunity in the U.S. is to make HungryPanda known and used by a wider audience. We are looking for a marketing leader who can see the bigger picture, build a plan for growth, and work hands\-on with the team to make it happen.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Outlandish Inc.** is a fast\-growing social commerce company and TikTok Shop Partner Agency helping brands, creators, and businesses grow through TikTok Shop, livestreaming, creator partnerships, content, and e\-commerce strategy.

We operate in a fast\-paced, highly creative environment where social media is at the center of what we do. We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager** who understands internet culture, knows what makes content perform, and can help build and grow the Outlandish brand across social platforms.

**About the Role:**

As our **Social Media Manager**, you will own and help execute Outlandish's day\-to\-day social media presence. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can think strategically while also jumping in to create, film, edit, post, and analyze content.

You should have a strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, be comfortable identifying trends and turning ideas into engaging content quickly, and understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance.

We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow trends, you understand why content works and can use performance data, audience behavior, and creative testing to continuously improve our social presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute Outlandish's overall social media strategy across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Own and maintain the social media content calendar, including planning, scheduling, publishing, and coordinating content.
* Create engaging short\-form content from concept through execution, including filming, editing, writing captions, and publishing.
* Develop creative concepts, hooks, scripts, recurring content series, and social campaigns that align with the Outlandish brand.
* Stay highly informed on TikTok, Instagram, creator economy, e\-commerce, social commerce, and internet trends.
* Identify relevant trends and quickly determine how they can be adapted authentically for the Outlandish brand.
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content from our team, offices, livestream studios, creators, events, and company initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify stories, projects, events, milestones, and educational opportunities that can become social content.
* Manage community engagement, including comments, messages, mentions, and opportunities to interact with our audience.
* Monitor social media performance and track KPIs including reach, views, engagement, follower growth, watch time, click\-through rates, and other relevant metrics.
* Use performance data to identify what is and isn't working and make recommendations for future content.
* Continuously test different hooks, formats, posting strategies, creative concepts, and content styles.
* Help strengthen and maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across platforms.
* Monitor competitors and industry leaders to identify emerging trends, content opportunities, and best practices.
* Support social coverage for company events, creator activations, livestreams, and other special projects as needed.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, including platform culture, trends, algorithms, and content best practices.
* Hands\-on experience creating short\-form video content for TikTok, Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
* Comfortable filming content using a phone or camera and editing short\-form videos.
* Experience with editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar platforms.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and what keeps viewers watching.
* Ability to write engaging, platform\-appropriate captions and social copy.
* Experience managing a content calendar and maintaining a consistent publishing schedule.
* Comfortable reviewing analytics and translating performance data into actionable content decisions.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and adapt when trends or business priorities change.
* Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple departments.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working with creators, influencers, or UGC content.
* Experience growing a brand's social media presence organically.
* Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools.
* Photography, videography, graphic design, or advanced video\-editing experience.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency, startup, creator, entertainment, or social\-first environment.

**What Success Looks Like:**

Success in this role means consistently creating content that strengthens the Outlandish brand, grows our audience, increases engagement, and keeps our social presence relevant within the rapidly changing world of social commerce.

You’ll be expected to bring ideas to the table, take ownership of execution, pay attention to performance, and continuously look for ways to make our content better.

**Why Join Outlandish?**

At Outlandish, you'll be working directly within the rapidly evolving world of TikTok Shop, creators, livestreaming, and social commerce. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with new ideas, create content around an exciting and growing industry, and play an important role in shaping how the Outlandish brand shows up online.

**If you're creative, social\-first, data\-aware, and always thinking about the next piece of content, we'd love to hear from you!**

At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

The GI Specialty Sales Representative (Pharma) will be responsible for the sales performance of the full portfolio within an assigned geographic territory through successful execution of marketing strategies. -----------------------

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - ACO Growth - SoCal
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Astrana Health is seeking a Business Development Representative \- ACO Growth to drive top\-of\-funnel growth and new partner acquisition for the organization’s Accountable Care Organization (ACO) initiatives. This role focuses on outbound prospecting, lead generation, and meeting development with physician groups, independent practices, and healthcare organizations interested in participating in value\-based care and ACO programs.  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of ACO Growth, this BDR plays a critical role in building the  

organization’s ACO pipeline by identifying qualified opportunities, initiating conversations with prospective partners, and supporting the sales process through follow\-up, relationship nurturing,  

and meeting coordination. As the role ramps and performance milestones are achieved, the BDR  

may also lead select smaller opportunities through the closing process, supporting expansion of  

the ACO network and physician participation. This position requires a high\-energy,  

entrepreneurial sales mindset, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in healthcare transformation and value\-based care.  

  

We are seeking candidates who are located in Southern California. Travel to physician practices across the West Coast will be required for this role.  

  

Our Values:  

* *Patients First*
* *Empowering the Independent Provider*
* *Be Innovative*
* *Operate with Integrity \& Deliver Excellence*
* *Team of One*
  

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Analyze market dynamics, provider landscapes, and competitive positioning to identify high\-value partnership opportunities
* Evaluate prospective providers based on strategic fit, growth potential, and alignment with value\-based care objectives
* Prioritize outreach and engagement efforts based on market needs, organizational goals, and potential return on investment
* Provide recommendations to leadership on target markets, provider segments, and outreach strategies
* Develop and execute targeted outreach strategies for engaging physician groups, practices, and healthcare organizations
* Lead initial engagement discussions with prospective partners, presenting value\-based care offerings and partnership opportunities
* Tailor messaging and engagement approaches based on provider type, size, and market conditions
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to advance partnership discussions
* Own and manage a pipeline of prospective ACO partners, ensuring alignment with strategic growth priorities
* Exercise judgment in advancing, pausing, or deprioritizing opportunities based on evolving business needs
* Lead follow\-up strategies and engagement plans to move opportunities through the pipeline
* As appropriate, independently manage lower\-complexity opportunities through later stages of the sales cycle
* Partner with internal stakeholders including Network Management, Operations, and Clinical teams to align partnership strategies
* Provide input into proposal development, partnership structuring, and engagement approaches
* Influence internal decision\-making by providing insights on provider needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics
* Analyze outreach effectiveness, pipeline conversion trends, and engagement outcomes to refine strategies
* Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and engagement tactics
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations to leadership to enhance ACO growth performance
* Conduct in\-person meetings, site visits, and presentations with prospective provider partners
* Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities
* Serve as a market\-facing representative to support brand awareness and relationship development
* Other duties as assigned

  

### **Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or inside sales
* Strong prospecting, outreach, and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage high volumes of outreach activity and maintain strong organization
* Proficiency with CRM tools and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* **Orange County resident preferred**
* **Bilingual Vietnamese preferred**

You're great for this role if you have:* Experience in healthcare, physician practice sales, managed care, or value\-based care
* Knowledge of ACO models, population health, or healthcare payment reform
* Experience with outbound prospecting tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, or  

 similar platforms
* Strong sales prospecting and lead generation capability
* Ability to build rapport quickly with physicians and healthcare leaders
* Highly motivated with a results\-driven mindset
* Strong follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced startup\-style growth environment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with senior leadership

### **Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions**

  

* This is a full\-time position. Working across time zones will be required per business need.
* This is a hybrid position, where you will be working remote with required travel across the US, predominantly across California/West Coast. Travel is expected up to 30% for the first year, however, we are seeking candidates who are interested in growing into a larger\-capacity role after year 1 with more frequent travel.
* The national target compensation for this position is $80,000 \- $120,000 annually, between base salary and bonus structure. Compensation will be comprised of a base salary between $80,000 \- $93,000 per year, as well as a performance\-based bonus structure. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job\-related factors.

Join our dynamic team as an Inside Sales Representative specializing in the electronic cigarette industry! This energetic role offers a fantastic opportunity to drive business growth through proactive client engagement, strategic negotiation, and innovative sales techniques.
