jobs.description:
**HVAC Sales Representative** 

**Flow Masters Plumbing, Inc.**  
**Location:** San Francisco \& Peninsula, CA  
**Position:** Full\-Time HVAC Sales  
**Compensation:** Base Salary \+ Commission

**About Flow Masters Plumbing**

Flow Masters Plumbing, Inc. is a growing plumbing, heating, and HVAC company serving residential, commercial, and property\-management customers throughout San Francisco and the Peninsula.

We are expanding our **HVAC Division** and are looking for a motivated, professional **HVAC Sales Representative / Comfort Advisor** who can help customers understand their options and confidently guide them through HVAC replacement and installation projects.

**The Role**

This is a **sales\-focused position**. You will meet with customers who are considering replacing, upgrading, or installing HVAC equipment and developing solutions based on their property, comfort needs, and budget.

You will work closely with our HVAC technicians, installers, dispatch team, and management from the initial sales opportunity through project handoff.

**Responsibilities**

* Meet with residential and commercial customers for HVAC sales opportunities
* Evaluate customers' existing HVAC systems and comfort needs
* Recommend appropriate HVAC replacement and upgrade options
* Sell furnaces, air\-conditioning systems, heat pumps, ductless mini\-splits, thermostats, and related HVAC solutions
* Prepare and present professional estimates and proposals
* Clearly explain equipment options, efficiency, warranties, installation requirements, and pricing
* Follow up consistently on open and unsold estimates
* Maintain accurate customer notes, sales activity, and follow\-up information in the company CRM
* Coordinate sold projects with the operations and installation teams
* Build strong relationships with homeowners, property managers, and commercial clients
* Identify additional opportunities while maintaining a customer\-first approach
* Meet individual and company sales goals
* Participate in ongoing product, technical, and sales training

**Qualifications**

We are looking for someone who has:

* HVAC sales experience strongly preferred
* Knowledge of residential and/or light\-commercial HVAC systems
* Understanding of furnaces, AC systems, heat pumps, and ductless mini splits
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to explain technical information in a way customers can easily understand
* Strong follow\-up and closing skills
* Professional appearance and customer\-service mindset
* Ability to use CRM, estimating, and mobile technology
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record
* Strong organization and time\-management skills

Previous experience as an **HVAC Advisor, HVAC Sales Representative, HVAC Technician, or HVAC Installer transitioning into sales** is especially welcome.

Knowledge of boilers, hydronic/radiant heating, plumbing, or water heating is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

Flow Masters Plumbing offers a competitive compensation package, including:

* Base salary plus commission
* Commission opportunities on qualifying estimates sold
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid sick leave
* Paid company holidays
* Company vehicle for qualified positions
* Fuel card
* Partial cellphone reimbursement
* Training and professional development
* Opportunity to grow with our expanding HVAC division

**Who We're Looking For**

We want someone who can combine **HVAC knowledge with professional sales ability**.

The right person is not simply looking to make a quick sale. We want someone who can listen to the customer, identify the right solution, explain the options clearly, follow up consistently, and build long\-term trust in Flow Masters Plumbing.

If you are experienced in HVAC and sales and want the opportunity to help grow an expanding HVAC division in the San Francisco market, we would like to hear from you.

**Please Note:**


The work territory of this position is the **Livermore, CA area.** You must live less than 1 hour away from the territory (including traffic) or willing to relocate on your own (relocation is not approved for this position) before your hire date.

  

Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.  



  

**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

 **JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

 **Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

 **Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

Design Development Coordinator \- PVH
The Design Development Coordinator drives the product development and commercialization process working with the internal/external cross functional partners (Design, Merch Planning, Raw Materials, Technical Design, Supply, Hub, Factory, Sales and Operations) to deliver product that meets business requirements for quality, aesthetic and price. * Partner with Design for seasonal development and new product launches
* Work with Design to initiate flash cost request; maintain cost request tracking log for follow up and receipt of costing information from Hub office
* Work with Design to create tech packages in PLM for initial season set up , ie, bill of material, model, and packaging BOM
* Lead initiatives that support tech pack accuracy to drive future data driven systems forward
* Initiate all sample requests
* Create Line Sheet with images in Visulon for Line Adoption \& Line Finalization milestone meetings
* Work with 3rd party vendor for production of selling tools – swatch card/references
* Partner with RM, QA, and Tech teams to ensure a seasonal risk assessment is complete
* Facilitate \& participate in seasonal product reviews to evaluate sample execution and alignment to tech pack requirements
* Oversee Late Add process and Line Adoption \& Finalization meetings
* Attend fit sessions to review details needed to prepare block/make detail requests
* Initiate and track style development from concept through production, ensuring all approvals are met per calendar deadlines
* Responsible for all daily communication with overseas offices
* Drive product development calendar adherence
* Build effective relationships with internal partners in Design, Sales, Merchandise Planning, and Supply and Operations to help execute cross functional synergy and collaboration
  

  

**What You'll Bring:**

  

  

* 1\-3 years’ experience recommended in product development, merchandising or other related work experience
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong sense of teamwork and ability to multitask
* Work independently
* Excellent communication skills
* Detail oriented and ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* High energy level and must work well under pressure

PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR EMPLOYEE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (EIN) WHEN APPLYING AND INDICATE IN YOUR COVER LETTER YOUR PERMANENT CIVIL SERVICE TITLE.
  

  

NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service.
  

  

DOF’s The Tax Audit and Enforcement Division is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by New York City. The division conducts audits related to corporate, personal, sales, and use taxes. City tax auditors conduct audits of selected audit candidates with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer and applying NYC rules and laws in accordance with the City’s policies and procedures.
  

  

The Office of Tax Audit is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by the City of New York. Tax Audit conducts audits of general corporation tax, business corporation tax, commercial rent tax, unincorporated business tax, hotel tax, utility tax, real property transfer tax, and bank tax. Tax Audit also conducts NYC personal income tax and sales and use tax audits within New York City. Tax auditors conduct audits of selected candidates in the various administered taxes, with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer. The Office of Tax Audit includes the Field Unit, which conducts audits in the field, and the Non\-field Unit, which conducts correspondence audits.
  

  

The Audit Candidate Analysis and Reporting/Review \& Quality Control Unit (ACAR/RQC) of the Tax Audit Division has an excellent promotional opportunity available for a highly motivated, organized and detail\-oriented individual to serve as an Administrative Operations Coordinator of the Unit. Reporting to the Director of the Tax Audit, the selected candidates’ duties and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:
  

  

* Coordinate, compile and process the typing and mailing of statutory \& non\-statutory notices for all closed audits conducted by the Department’s Audit and Enforcement Division. Prepare complete mailing packages along with their related notices and attachments.
* Reconcile the mailed documents to the daily mail log and trace them to their related postal receipts. Document and trouble shoot discrepancies and communicate in a clear concise manner with the mailroom staff to resolve issues.
* Maintain complete, detailed records of all mailed notices and their related certified receipts for quick reference.
* Compile respective Statement of Audit Adjustment (A21\.5\) and submit it neatly and timely to the New York State representative monthly.
* Train all new Clerical Support staff members in the numerous tasks conducted by the Unit.
* Coordinate with the various Unit’s clerical support staff to document, file and return all incoming and outgoing completed cases. Maintain detailed records.
* Monitor and maintain equipment and supply needs and request, accordingly, ensuring that supplies are always on hand. Report and trouble shoot computer, printer and scanner related problems.
* Retrieve all relevant legal documents, case folder, and receipts based on the request of the Conciliation Bureau.
* Perform general office administrative functions and special projects requested by the Director.
* Independently develop and create reports for the Director. Such work may include but is not limited to staff related reports.

  

Additional Information:
  

  

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  

  

This position may be eligible for remote work up to 2 days per week, pursuant to the Remote Work Pilot Program agreed between the City and the Collective Bargaining Unit representing employees serving in the civil service title.

jobs.title: Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**STARR Restaurants** is seeking an ambitious, organized, and hospitality\-minded **Events Coordinator** to join our amazing team in New York City. This position is largely remote, but requires flexibility to meet onsite as business demands.


Working closely with our Senior Director of Events and Event Sales Managers, this position provides hands\-on administrative and coordination support for a diverse portfolio of affiliated STARR Restaurants, including:


Buddakan NY \| Pastis NY \| Le Café Louis Vuitton \| Le Coucou \| Babbo \| The Clocktower \| Electric Lemon \| El Vez \| Upland


We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership. For the right candidate, this is more than a coordinator position — it is an opportunity to learn from experienced event professionals, demonstrate your capabilities, and grow into greater responsibility within the organization.

 **This position offers a comprehensive package including:**

* Base Salary Range of $70,000–$80,000
* Paid Vacation and Sick Time
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits Coverage
* Referral Bonus Programs
* Dining Discounts at 25\+ affiliated STARR Restaurants

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support Event Sales Managers with day\-to\-day event sales and administrative needs.
* Respond to and qualify incoming event inquiries, including checking availability, suggesting alternative dates, and cross\-selling affiliated STARR Restaurant venues.
* Maintain accurate event bookings and availability across reservation and event\-management platforms.
* Maintain **Tripleseat**, including event details, menus, beverage selections, and picklists.
* Prepare and distribute weekly BEO packets and daily final BEOs to Restaurant Managers, Chefs, and relevant hospitality partners.
* Cross\-check BEOs against reservation platforms to ensure accuracy of dates, times, and event details.
* Communicate with Restaurant Managers, Chefs, Beverage Managers, and other internal teams regarding event availability, approvals, menus, and operational details.
* Maintain and update event menus in collaboration with Chefs and Event Sales Managers.
* Create customized event menus and collateral using **Adobe InDesign**.
* Assist with vendor coordination, including Certificates of Insurance, security requirements, and load\-in logistics.
* Assist with party rental orders and other event\-related logistics.
* Support Event Sales initiatives including competitive analysis, marketing projects, and departmental special projects.
* Provide additional support to the Events team as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* **2–3\+ years of experience** in event sales, event coordination, hospitality, restaurants, hotels, catering, or a related field.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong follow\-through and the ability to anticipate needs.
* Professional and confident when communicating with management, culinary teams, vendors, and clients.
* Experience with **Tripleseat** or another event\-management/CRM platform preferred.
* Experience with **OpenTable, Resy**, or other restaurant reservation platforms.
* Working knowledge of **Adobe InDesign**; experience creating menus or event collateral strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office and Google Workspace**.
* Hospitality\-minded with a polished, professional, and service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple restaurants and departments.

*Equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

Administrative Coordinator (aHEO) \- Human Resources


**POSITION DETAILS**


Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Administrative Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for the Office of Human Resources The position is responsible for ensuring professional front desk operations while managing administrative office functions, coordinating office operations, supporting budget and purchasing activities, and providing administrative support to the Director of Operations and the Human Resources Office. The position coordinates departmental activities, supports special projects and operational initiatives, and helps ensure the efficient delivery of HR services to the College community.


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the Office of Human Resources by greeting visitors, answering, screening, and directing telephone calls, and responding to general inquiries from employees, applicants, retirees, and members of the College community.
* Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative operations of the Human Resources Office, including office workflow, supply and inventory needs, purchasing activities, service requests, records, and general administrative support.
* Receive, review, and route HR documents, employment applications, and correspondence to the appropriate Human Resources staff.
* Provide administrative support to the Director of Operations, including coordinating calendars, scheduling meetings, preparing correspondence, reports, presentations, and other administrative materials.
* Provide administrative support to the Talent Acquisition and Engagement team by assisting with recruitment activities, interview scheduling, onboarding, employee engagement initiatives, and other hiring\-related functions.
* Assist with departmental projects, operational initiatives, and administrative activities across multiple Human Resources functions.
* Order office supplies, monitor inventory, process purchasing and vendor requests, and assist with budget tracking, invoice processing, and other administrative and fiscal activities.
* Maintain confidential departmental records, files, and documentation in accordance with College and University policies.
* Prepare reports, maintain spreadsheets, track assignments, and assist with data collection and analysis using Microsoft Office and University systems.
* Collaborate with Human Resources staff to support departmental operations and perform related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor’s degree required.


Preferred Qualifications:


* Experience providing administrative support in a Human Resources, higher education, or other professional office environment.
* Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint); experience with HRIS or ERP systems (e.g., CUNYfirst or Workday) is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.

**CUNY TITLE OVERVIEW**


Supports projects, initiatives, and activities that impact an academic or administrative department.


* Manages basic office functions such as communications, meeting schedules, work plans, staff assignments, and distributing information.
* Collects data for, prepares, and distributes reports and presentations using word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
* Updates office databases, lists, and files to ensure completeness and accuracy; maintains current information on department web site(s); maintains department archives and collections.
* Conducts internet and/or database research and performs basic systems queries to locate information related to department activities.
* Maintains department fiscal plans and budgets; assists in budget administration and invoice processing.
* Provides basic information, instructions, and materials as requested by students, faculty, and others who contact the department.
* May supervise office staff and student workers.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

Administrative and Central Office

  

  

  

**Office Title/Functional Title:**  

  

Procurement Coordinator, BERS \- 27211

Community Coordinator

Board of Education Retirement System

Manhattan

10/08/2026  

  

  

  

  

**Description:**  

  

**Position Summary:** Under the supervision of the Deputy Director, Contracts and Procurement, the Procurement Coordinator will support and coordinate the development and management of procurement activities. Performs related work.  

**Reports to:** Deputy Director, Contracts and Procurement  

**Direct Reports:** N/A  

**Key Relationships** Engagement with BERS departments, external community and business partners.


**Responsibilities**  

* Coordinate, monitor and collaborate on a variety of special projects requiring research, analysis, and planning to support BERS operations on behalf of the prospective, current and retired membership community.
* Support project coordination and technical assistance to internal stakeholders, external community and business partners.
* Interact with internal and external parties to ensure efficiency and improvement in communication between BERS and the vendor/contractor community.
* Support, monitor and coordinate project workflows by closely working with internal and external community partners to ensure that all procurement activities are compliant with the necessary requirements.
* Conduct, coordinate and update analyses and presentations using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and other analytical tools assigned.
* Coordinate and support research pertaining to Contractor/Vendor Responsibility determination and performance evaluations.
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor project progress/updates via status trackers, analysis, briefs, and memos.
* Coordinate and support responses to internal and external community inquiries by researching historical contract information in various systems and resources.
* Track and review requests for long distance travel and reimbursements to ensure compliance with BERS policies and procedures.
  

**Qualification Requirements:**


**Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two (2\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six (6\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to “1” or “2” above. However, all candidates must have at least one (1\) year of experience as described in “1” above.


*Plus*
In addition to meeting the minimum requirements, individuals must have two additional years of relevant work experience.  

**Preferred**  

* Self\-starter with a sense of urgency who can adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast paced environment.
* Able to work under pressure and to meet deadlines consistently.
* Possess strong written and spoken communication skills and attention to detail.
* Proven ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of project managers, administrative staff, and vendor community.
* Ability to collaborate on a team and with a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with a high attention to detail and follow through.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 Application.
* Time management skills, especially when handling multiple high\-priority projects simultaneously.
* Knowledge of financial, accounting, and procurement management systems; experience with PASSPort is preferred.
* Understanding of, or interest in, public sector procurement.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills; strong critical writing skills.
* Ability to multitask and complete job functions in an orderly, efficient manner.

**Salary**: $72,114 \- $85,000

  

(Internal candidates who are selected for this position and who currently hold comparable or less senior positions within the DOE will not earn less than their current salary.)

  

**Please include a resume and cover letter with your application.**


**NOTE: The filling of all positions is subject to budget availability and/or grant funding.**

  

**\* New York City Residency is NOT Required \***


**We encourage all applicants from the New York City tri\-state area to apply.**

jobs.title: Community Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti\-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win\-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi\-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on\-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de\-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows\-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

  

All job descriptions and required skills, qualifications and responsibilities for a particular position are subject to modification by the Company from time to time, in the Company’s discretion based on business necessity.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with advertising sales, business development, online media environment, or sales\-oriented marketing roles.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in the financial industry with knowledge of and established relationships within the advertising and tech industries.
* Expert knowledge and achievement in Brand and Performance marketing and media operations and sales.
* Knowledge of traditional and contemporary/online marketing tactics and strategy.
* Significant record of collaborative, humble, and others\-empowering leadership style resulting in support from peers and managers.
* Record of success building relationships with and selling to middle managers through executives at the global enterprises.
* Material quantitative and technical skills relevant to digital and traditional media strategy, planning, buying, and measurement.

**About the job**
-----------------


Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.



Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how
  

Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market\-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $88000 \- $124000 (USD) \+ 35% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Optimize business growth potential and enhance growth across the client portfolio.
* Understand key clients business goals and current video, display, and search advertising strategies.
* Develop forward thinking, data\-driven analyses and consultative recommendations that align with customer goals, and quantify high\-impact opportunities with clear recommendations to present to customers.
* Respond to media briefs and RFPs, identifying and presenting opportunities.
* Act as a liaison with clients and agencies regarding new product launches and advertising opportunities and manage ongoing customer training and collateral.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Key Account Manager (Hospital Pharma Accounts)
jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic\-related diseases.

  

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

  

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

 **Position Summary:**  

  

The Key Account Manager (Hospital/Pharma) will be responsible for the Sales performance, protocol development and contracting within Key Accounts of the assigned geographic territory through successful execution of Marketing strategies. The role is responsible for developing business plans to grow business through building relationships with key decision makers and influencers including big hospital systems, clinics and specialty pharmacies.

  

The Key Account Manager will also be responsible for focused customer engagement and sales presentations to specific targets to support to expand the GI Pharma platform. This will be executed through carefully defined messaging strategy, call sequence, leveraging business and value solutions based on evidence and outcome data. This role will also work with appropriate IDN Hospital personnel in regards to transition of care and discharge protocols.

* ***Territory Location***: This territory includes **all 5 Boroughs of New York City (Manhattan, the Bronx, Queens, Staten Island and Brooklyn, NY).**

  

  

**Responsibilities:*** Account development and planning through identification of individual account business model and process, including key decision makers, influencers, and protocol; with focus on patient discharge and transition of care process.
* Focus on driving growth among Hospital accounts, GI/Critical Care target and new accounts; Must meet/exceed sales and profit objectives in assigned accounts and territory.
* Educate targeted healthcare providers on the benefits of a novel GI therapy (Vowst) within assigned territory.
* Develop/assess hospital account protocols, infectious disease and GI healthcare environment, and appropriately create and execute the account management and selling process in a manner that is concise, compliant, professional and persuasive; and which addresses a need and leads the customer to action.
* Develop and communicate deep scientific understanding of GI disorders, assigned, and competitive products within the GI marketplace.
* Cultivate and maintain long\-term business relationships with key accounts and key opinion leaders within the GI community.
* Develop and implement a territory specific business plan and utilize all available resources to foster a successful sales environment.
* Effectively convey complex clinical and reimbursement product information to key stakeholders in a highly competitive marketplace.
* Execute a customer\-centric needs\-based selling approach with targeted Healthcare Providers and accounts.
* Utilize the sales reporting systems on a regular basis for call preparation, to record and track sales activity and to gather market intelligence data.
* Organize meetings and deliver content to health care professionals on the topic of GI and nutrition aligned with tangible account objects and metrics as defined by the customer.
* Conduct promotional programs for professional audiences and attend local, regional and national meetings as directed.
* Collaboratively working with internal and external partners in making introductions and connecting to hospital personnel.

 **Requirements:**  

  

* Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced degree in Nursing, Dietetics, MBA or Pharm.D., is highly preferred.
* 6\-7\+ years of Pharma Sales experience with demonstrated success of selling Specialty Medical products into Hospitals (Medical Device, Infectious Disease, Rare Disease or GI) required.
* Demonstrated fluency in MS Office (Word/Excel/Outlook/PowerPoint) is required.
* Must have excellent communication (oral and written), presentation, organizational and stakeholder management skills (including the ability to develop and maintain strong, cross\-functional stakeholder relationships).
* Willing and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Must have current or prior strategic account planning, strong business acumen, as well as strong financial and analytical skills.
* Knowledge of value\-based selling and experience with negotiating, clinical influence and account penetration/call planning is required.
* Must be able to work through change management and must be agile.
* Ability to meet or exceed Sales targets and to be data\-driven is a must.
* Current or prior experience with data systems such as Power BI, Salesforce, Circana and/or other systems is preferred.
* Willing and able to travel between 50% to 70% based on the needs of the team, territory clients or the business required.

jobs.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Mid\-Market Account Manager!
  
  

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and excel at problem\-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!
  
  

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same\-day and next\-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e\-commerce and product\-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.
  
  

**Location:** Remote, located on the east coast with a focus on New England \- This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.
  
**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $67,200 \- $84,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $67,200 \- $100,800\. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job\-related factors.
  
  

**Employment Logistics:**  

The Mid\-Market Account Manager plays a critical role in supporting existing customers and driving growth by increasing package volume shipped with OnTrac. This is a long\-cycle sales role focused on building strong relationships, ensuring exceptional service, and delivering solutions that meet customer needs. Success in this position requires a proactive approach to account management, operational support, and collaboration with internal teams to maximize territory effectiveness.
  
  

**Unpacking the Benefits:**  

Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure\-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2\) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\*
* Six (6\) paid company holidays
* Two (2\) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4\) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs


Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.
  
  

**The Must\-Haves:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 4–8 years of experience in account management or related field
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​


**Your Mission in Motion:**  

A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.

Chase is a leader in banking, credit card and wealth management services, helping nearly one out of every two American households make the most of their money.


As an Executive Ambassador Programs Operations Associate within Consumer and Community Banking you will help senior leaders build their public profiles through social thought leadership, advancing the firm's strategy and culture. **Job responsibilities**


* Manage recurring program workflows, calendars, trackers and status updates across the executive cohort, maintain onboarding and offboarding materials, permission forms, access records, executive lists and communicator preferences and coordinate onboarding logistics and support smooth transitions when executives or communicators join, leave or change roles

* Apply LinkedIn best practices and program standards while flagging content that requires strategic, legal or leadership review and maintain legal approval logs and audit evidence when legal review is required
* Support daily monitoring of executive posts and comments during established coverage hours, draft recommended responses and reactions for executive communicator review, reflecting the executive's preferences and voice and coordinate timely follow\-up with executive communicators and escalate customer complaints, sensitive comments or time\-critical issues through the appropriate process.

* Conduct quality checks, identify data issues and coordinate resolution with platform or reporting partners; Turn performance data into practical recommendations for content, cadence and executive engagement, support procedure updates, control testing, evidence collection and recertification activities and follow applicable social media, legal, privacy and records\-management requirements.
* Build trusted working relationships with executive communicators, social and content teams, PR, video, paid media, controls and legal partners, escalate process gaps, unclear ownership or potential risks promptly and communicate priorities, deadlines, dependencies and status clearly.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Support trainings, office hours, program meetings and ad hoc initiatives as needed.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**


* 3\+ years of relevant experience in social media operations, employee advocacy, executive communications, program management or a related field.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority workflows independently.
* Strong writing, editing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience with social media publishing, monitoring and analytics tools, including Sprinklr and LinkedIn analytics.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel, including reporting and data quality review.

* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of legal, compliance and records\-management requirements for social media.
* Experience supporting executive social media or thought leadership programs.
* Basic design or multimedia skills in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. * Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.

**Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience including completion of the Sysco Sales Internship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Vascular Services
jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative \- Vascular Services  
Employment Type: Full\-Time  
Location: New York City, NY  
Travel: Local travel required throughout the territory  
Reports To: VP of Operations  


Position Summary  


We are seeking a motivated and personable Business Development Representative to develop new business relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living communities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare facilities.  


The primary responsibility of this position is to identify facilities that could benefit from our vascular services, establish relationships with administrators and healthcare decision\-makers, educate them about our services, and develop referral partnerships that generate new business.  


This is a relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position for someone who enjoys meeting people, making connections, and developing long\-term business relationships in the healthcare community.  


Key Responsibilities  


Identify and develop relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare organizations.  
Research and identify potential facilities that have a need for vascular services.  
Contact facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Medical Directors, case managers, discharge planners, and other appropriate decision\-makers.  
Attend Quality meetings at facilities  
Schedule and conduct in\-person visits and presentations with facility leadership and healthcare staff.  
Explain our vascular services and how we can support their residents and patients.  
Develop referral relationships and establish our company as a trusted vascular\-service provider.  
Follow up consistently with prospective and existing facility partners.  
Maintain a pipeline of prospective facilities and track contacts, meetings, referrals, and business opportunities.  
Work closely with our clinical and operations teams to ensure a smooth transition from referral to patient care.  
Attend healthcare networking events, industry meetings, and community events to develop new relationships.  
Identify opportunities to expand services within existing facility relationships.  
Maintain accurate records of business\-development activities and report progress to management.  
Meet established goals for facility outreach, meetings, new relationships, and referrals.  


Ideal Candidate  


The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated, outgoing, and persistent relationship builder who is comfortable approaching healthcare organizations and developing business from the ground up.  


Experience in healthcare sales or business development is preferred, particularly experience working with:  


Nursing homes  
Skilled nursing facilities  
Assisted\-living facilities  
Home health agencies  
Hospice organizations  
Hospitals  
Rehabilitation facilities  
Physician practices  
Long\-term care organizations  


Candidates with strong sales, networking, marketing, or healthcare relationship\-building experience will also be considered.  


Qualifications  


Previous experience in business development, sales, healthcare marketing, or account management preferred.  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Comfortable making cold calls and conducting face\-to\-face meetings.  
Professional and confident when speaking with healthcare administrators and clinical leadership.  
Highly organized and able to manage multiple prospects and relationships.  
Self\-directed and able to work independently.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to healthcare facilities.  
Ability to build trust and maintain long\-term professional relationships.  
Familiarity with the long\-term\-care and senior\-care healthcare environment is a plus.  


Performance Expectations  


Success in this position will be measured by activities and results such as:  


Number of qualified facilities identified.  
Facility visits and decision\-maker meetings.  
New facility relationships established.  
New referral partnerships developed.  
Referral volume generated.  
Growth of business within existing facility accounts.  
Consistent follow\-up and maintenance of the sales pipeline.  


Compensation:  


We are open to structuring compensation with a base salary or hourly rate plus performance\-based incentives tied to successful business development and new facility relationships.  


Why Join Us?  


This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding access to vascular services for residents and patients in long\-term\-care and assisted\-living communities.  


The successful candidate will have the opportunity to build a healthcare referral network, develop meaningful professional relationships, and directly contribute to the growth of the organization.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Feminism & Legal Theory Project - Emory School of Law
jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:* Design, implement, and coordinate operational facets of a specific Law School program including program\-related workshops, events, and/or meetings.
* Develop work plans to accomplish program goals and objectives and monitor progress toward their achievement.
* Serve as a liaison to and interact with individuals, groups, and organizations participating in the program or seeking knowledge of the program.
* Develop promotional and communication materials which may include content for reports, briefings, newsletters, grants or other written information related to the program.
* Coordinate with the law library to manage access to, update, and maintain the Feminism and Legal Theory Project Archive.
* Facilitate international visiting scholar program (including J\-1 and H\-1B visas) in conjunction with the International Student and Scholar Services office, supporting visiting scholars throughout their interactions with the VHC/FLT.
* Manage communications, coordination, and event\-planning for hybrid and in\-person international academic workshops, visiting scholar presentations, and other events annually as needed.
* Produce, interview, and edit audiovisual materials, including a monthly podcast and the oral history project, developed for the VHC and FLT.
* Prepare annual reports.
* Process departmental expenses.
* Coordinate with other law school departments to facilitate project goals.
* Support project guests, including professors, students, postdoctoral fellows, and visiting scholars.
* May assist in identifying funding resources and in developing fund\-raising strategies and initiatives.
* May maintain and update the departmental website.
* May supervise program interns, fellows, and volunteers.


ADDITIONAL JOB DETAILS:* Develop a working knowledge of all aspects of the Feminism and Legal Theory Project (FLT) and the Vulnerability and the Human Condition Initiative (VHC).
* Maintain complete and accurate records to ensure compliance with immigration regulations for visiting scholars.
* Collaborate with visiting researchers, postdoctoral fellows, undergraduate students, and law students interested in the projects.
* Review and edit grant applications, project publications, social media, monthly digest, visiting scholar papers and presentations, books and articles, and additional materials as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* Bachelor's degree in a field related to the program and two years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:* Demonstrated ability to prioritize incoming work, manage information, and provide value\-added service to others,
* Cultural fluency and ability to work well with academics of various professional and cultural backgrounds,
* Prior knowledge of or interest in feminism, law, legal theory, sociology, political science, philosophy, or social justice,
* Familiarity or comfort with learning audiovisual editing programs such as Audacity, Canva, KDENlive, and/or Vimeo, or comfort with various technologies.
* Ability to learn new programs and proactively apply creative solutions, and
* Attention to detail.

  

NOTE: Position tasks are generally required to be performed in\-person at an Emory University location. Remote work from home day options may be granted at department discretion. Emory reserves the right to change remote work status with notice to employee.


Additional Details: Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Emory University complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veteran's Readjustment Assistance Act, and applicable executive orders, federal and state regulations regarding nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and affirmative action (for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities). jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Hamlin Group is adding an Operations Coordinator to create operational leverage across the business — taking ownership of the administrative, coordination, and follow\-through work that currently pulls leadership away from design, sales, and high\-value client decisions.


You will work alongside company leadership and the Design \& Selections Coordinator, managing the day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep a luxury residential remodeling firm running. This is a developmental role. You will start by learning our systems, our standards, and how we operate. Over time, as you develop confidence and capability, you will take on more ownership and responsibility. What we are looking for is not someone who has done all of this before — we are looking for someone with a solid foundation, a sharp mind, and the drive to build the rest with our guidance.


We are a small company that operates at a standard most firms twice our size don't reach. That means every person on this team matters, dependability is a requirement, and when you say you have something, you see it through.

**Work Environment**

* On\-site — Chamblee, GA office
* Monday through Friday, standard business hours
* Occasional local errands or permit office visits as needed
* Professional, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture

**The Right Person**


We are looking for someone who operates a certain way — not just someone who checks the right boxes on a resume.


You notice what others miss. You finish what you start. You create order out of ambiguity and don't require repeated reminders. You ask good questions, document the answers, and don't need to be taught the same thing twice. When something is off track, you communicate early. When a problem lands in front of you, your instinct is to solve it — not just report it. You can manage multiple workstreams without losing details, and you take pride in the fact that things run better because you are in the room.

 **Compensation:**
$65,000

 **Responsibilities:*** **Lead Management \& Client Communication** — Serve as the first point of contact for incoming leads. Field calls and emails, hold initial conversations to understand the project and determine fit, and manage lead information in our project management system. You are the first professional voice a potential client hears.
* **Invoice \& Expense Processing** — Manage trade contractor invoice processing, expense coding, and payment tracking with guidance from the project team. You will learn how our project budgets work and grow into running this process independently.
* **Trade Contractor \& Vendor Coordination** — Handle outbound communication with trade contractors and vendors — preparing and sending bid requests and work orders, following up on schedules and estimates, placing and tracking material orders, and coordinating the occasional pickup or delivery.
* **Project Administration** — Keep our project management system organized and current — setting up new projects, maintaining project files and records, monitoring daily log submissions, coordinating permit filings, maintaining office supplies, and supporting the team with basic quantity takeoffs when needed.
* **Technology \& AI Operations** — Work within AI platforms like Claude and ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow. We have built operational tools and workflows using these platforms, and this role will execute, manage, and help grow them. This is not casual AI use — it is a working part of how we operate.
* **Leadership \& Team Support** — Keep leadership on schedule with proactive calendar management. Coordinate with the design team on photography scheduling and warranty follow\-ups. When something needs to happen and nobody else is carrying it, you pick it up.

 **Qualifications:****Required**

* Strong organizational and communication skills — written and verbal
* A working familiarity with residential construction — you don't need to build a house, but you shouldn't be starting from scratch on basic terminology and concepts
* Comfort with technology and a genuine willingness to work with AI tools as part of daily operations
* Detail\-oriented with a basic understanding of invoicing, budgets, and payment tracking
* Self\-directed, dependable, and eager to grow into increasing responsibility
* Located in the Atlanta metropolitan area

**Preferred — Not Required**

* Experience in a construction, design\-build, or remodeling office environment
* Familiarity with construction project management software such as JobTread (our platform), BuilderTrend, or CoConstruct
* Experience with accounts payable or expense management
* Comfort reading residential floor plans
* Prior professional use of AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT

 **About Company**  

The Hamlin Group is an architect\-led, design\-build firm specializing in luxury residential remodeling in the greater Atlanta area. We are a small team that operates at a high standard — defined by craftsmanship, intention, and a refusal to cut corners. This role grows with the company, and the right person will find a long\-term home here.

**Our Mission**  

At The Hamlin Group, we set the standard for luxury home remodeling — driven by pride, precision, and purpose. We build spaces that inspire and a culture that refuses to cut corners — because excellence isn't our goal, it's our baseline.

**Our Core Values — H.A.M.L.I.N.**

* Honor Craftsmanship
* Attention to Design
* Measured \& Intentional
* Luxury Through Collaboration
* Integrity at Every Step
* Never Settle

jobs.title: Partnerships Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Remote role in the USA**

**Role Overview**

Uncapped lends working capital to e\-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.


We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.


You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.


This is a hands\-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

**About Uncapped**

Founded in 2019, **Uncapped** is a leading fintech provider of working \& growth capital to e\-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting\-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e\-commerce platforms — including **Amazon and Walmart** — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

**What will you do ✍️**

**1\. Recruitment: bring new partners in**


Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.

**2\. Activation: get them to a first funded deal**


Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.

**3\. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed**


The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co\-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.

**4\. The long tail: run it as a program**


Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always\-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self\-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.

**5\. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number**


Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.

**6\. Partner economics and commission**


Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.

**7\. Reporting and forecasting**


Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and originations, measured against plan. You will be the person who explains the number each week, including in the weeks it is bad.

 **Requirements** **Who you are**

**Must have**

* 3\+ years in partnerships, channel sales, or a similar commercial role. Lending, fintech, payments or e\-commerce SaaS is useful background but not essential
* A track record of building pipeline from scratch and converting it, whether that was partners, direct sales or something else
* Comfort owning a revenue number and reporting against a plan
* Working knowledge of a GTM stack. A CRM plus at least one of a PRM, a sequencing tool or a lifecycle marketing platform. You should be happy setting things up yourself rather than raising a request for it

**Nice to have**

* PartnerStack, HubSpot, Clay, Instantly, HeyReach or Customer.io specifically
* SQL, or a habit of building your own reporting rather than waiting for it
* Having worked on building a channel, rather than inheriting one that already ran

 **Benefits**  

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start\-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

* Competitive base \+ uncapped commission — top performers earn meaningfully
* Unlimited holiday — well\-rested people make the best closers
* MacBook
* Personal growth fund — raise your game from great to spectacular
* Monthly recognition and awards — celebrate wins big and small
* The opportunity to close deals every day with **US e\-commerce founders** building real businesses

**We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.**
