new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II - West
new_jobs.description:
Founded in 2018 with co\-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results.



Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor\-agnostic integrating with any API\-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest\-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it's popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security\-focused teams.



At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We're excited about what's next, and we're looking for others to join us on our journey.

***This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.***



The **Customer Success Manager** role will play a critical part in the exciting growth trajectory of Tines. As an automation platform, the more the customer automates, the more value they see. Your role will be to drive adoption and expand the usage across the customer base, ensuring that our customers realize the full potential of the platform. Alongside expansion with existing teams, you will play a crucial part in our strategy to expand outside of security teams into other functions in our clients (IT, Engineering, Operations).



You will do this by supporting our customers from onboarding to ongoing support to expansion and renewals. You will become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Tines product, helping foster champions within the customer who will identify automation opportunities across their organization. At the same time, you will provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, helping us shape the future of the product. The role will also partner closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other internal teams.


**What you will be doing:**


* Leading a first\-class onboarding experience and ensuring customer use cases and requirements are met in the specified timeline
* Translating technical customer needs to internal technical teams and delivering feedback to the Product team on new feature requests and enhancements to shape and improve the platform
* Coordinating onboarding and business reviews to evaluate performance, learn about the customers priorities, and locate new opportunities to promote expansion within existing and new teams
* Partnering with internal resources to build account plans and align customer needs with use cases to increase platform usage
* Proactively identify risks to the customer achieving their stated goals, and work with the CSM / PM teams to develop and drive a comprehensive risk mitigation plan
* Identifying issues that impact customers and/or challenges in the business and are able to provide thought leadership in finding a customer solution or assist in co\-development of process improvement, programs and/or assets
* Developing and driving a renewal plan and delivering a strategic message to analysts, management, and the C\-Suite on the value of Tines and next steps for the account
* Review account dashboards, metrics, log\-ins, and use cases to determine the health of the customer


**What you bring with you:**


* 3\+ years of experience in a technical account management, customer success, or post\-sales role at a technology company
* Experience with a SaaS solutions offering for technical teams (cybersecurity, DevOps, IT, other)
* Experience asking questions to uncover problems, locate new opportunities, and translate technical requirements to internal teams and partners
* Knowledge of API's \+ how they function


**Target Annual Earnings (salary \+ commission): $125K OTE**

  


*Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

  

***\#LI\-SW1***

  

At Tines, we're all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you're second\-guessing your application, we hope you'll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn't always easy, especially if you're thinking of a career pivot – but we're big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you've nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We'd love to hear from you.


***Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.***

new_jobs.title: Partner Customer Success Manager (Accounting)
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, our Partner Success Managers (PSMs) are the **cornerstone of our relationship with our most influential accounting partners**. This role is a mission\-critical position that directly impacts the success of accounting firms who, in turn, recommend and manage our products for countless businesses. As a PSM, you will **own the end\-to\-end journey** for a portfolio of high\-value firms as a dedicated strategic partner and trusted advisor. This is a leadership role for someone who runs their book of business like an owner. You'll join at a stage where the approach is still taking shape — an opportunity to help refine and sharpen how this function operates, and to influence the model as it matures rather than simply inheriting a finished one. Your mission is to foster deep, lasting relationships, drive platform adoption, and quarterback complex integrations and implementations to ensure a seamless, premium VIP experience.

  

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams to ensure proactive engagement, and as a trusted advisor, help firms **unlock the full value of Intuit’s ecosystem in a seamless experience.** We’re looking for an entrepreneurial self\-starter — someone who is customer\-obsessed, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked, and treats every firm’s success as their own. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, customer\-centric environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are passionate about empowering our partners to succeed, this role is for you.

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead your portfolio like an owner: bring an entrepreneurial mindset to identify opportunities, make fast decisions, and drive outcomes proactively rather than reactively.
* Serve as a dedicated strategic partner, ensuring accounting firms fully leverage Intuit’s platform to meet their needs.
* Manage the end\-to\-end firm experience from implementation to renewal, connecting the right teams—Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams—to ensure a cohesive and high\-quality experience that drives accountant satisfaction and platform adoption.
* Act as an accountant advocate, anticipating challenges and coordinating with internal teams (Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product teams) to resolve issues efficiently, moving with speed and urgency to unblock firms.
* Conduct regular check\-ins, business reviews, and proactive outreach to assess firm health and provide guidance.
* Drive ongoing product education for firms on platform features, product capabilities, and best practice, helping them extract maximum value.
* Monitor key success metrics including support KPIs, usage trends, and subscription growth / attrition indicators to identify expansion and retention opportunities in partnership with the Sales team.
* Lead retention and renewal planning to ensure Accountants see long\-term value and remain engaged.
* Capture and translate recurring product pain points into roadmap insights, advocating for enhancements that improve the accountant experience.

 **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated leadership and an entrepreneurial mindset — a self\-starter who takes full ownership of outcomes, moves fast, and drives results independently in ambiguous situations.
* Comfortable working within an evolving framework — able to operate effectively today while helping refine and strengthen the approach as it develops.
* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B client or partner engagement.
* Working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals and accounting firm workflows, with 1\+ years experience in an accounting/bookkeeping environment.
* Strong background in accounting or bookkeeping, with a preference for experience in a mid\-market environment. This includes an understanding of complex financial management systems and familiarity with AI\-driven forecasting.
* Proven track record of driving product adoption, improving retention, and delivering business value within a large\-scale matrixed organization.
* Strategic problem solving skills and critical thinking to proactively identify risks and implement solutions. You can look beyond the "here and now" to foresee challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* Data\-driven mindset with proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Quickbase, Salesforce) and analytics dashboards, leveraging insights to drive seamless firm experiences.
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills, capable of guiding Accounting Firms at all levels.
* 2\+ years experience in SaaS, cloud\-based enterprise solutions, or financial management platforms.

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
* Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
* Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go\-to\-market teams.

  

Cross\-functional collaboration* Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
* Work with marketing to develop analyst\-specific content programs, agency co\-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid\-market ERP ecosystem.
* Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst\-generated content and recommendations.

* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.

NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service.
  

  

DOF’s The Tax Audit and Enforcement Division is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by New York City. The division conducts audits related to corporate, personal, sales, and use taxes. City tax auditors conduct audits of selected audit candidates with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer and applying NYC rules and laws in accordance with the City’s policies and procedures.
  

  

The Office of Tax Audit is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by the City of New York. Tax Audit conducts audits of general corporation tax, business corporation tax, commercial rent tax, unincorporated business tax, hotel tax, utility tax, real property transfer tax, and bank tax. Tax Audit also conducts NYC personal income tax and sales and use tax audits within New York City. Tax auditors conduct audits of selected candidates in the various administered taxes, with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer. The Office of Tax Audit includes the Field Unit, which conducts audits in the field, and the Non\-field Unit, which conducts correspondence audits.
  

  

The Audit Candidate Analysis and Reporting/Review \& Quality Control Unit (ACAR/RQC) of the Tax Audit Division has an excellent promotional opportunity available for a highly motivated, organized and detail\-oriented individual to serve as an Administrative Operations Coordinator of the Unit. Reporting to the Director of the Tax Audit, the selected candidates’ duties and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Maintain complete, detailed records of all mailed notices and their related certified receipts for quick reference.
* Compile respective Statement of Audit Adjustment (A21\.5\) and submit it neatly and timely to the New York State representative monthly.
* Train all new Clerical Support staff members in the numerous tasks conducted by the Unit.
* Coordinate with the various Unit’s clerical support staff to document, file and return all incoming and outgoing completed cases. Maintain detailed records.
* Monitor and maintain equipment and supply needs and request, accordingly, ensuring that supplies are always on hand. Report and trouble shoot computer, printer and scanner related problems.
* Retrieve all relevant legal documents, case folder, and receipts based on the request of the Conciliation Bureau.
* Perform general office administrative functions and special projects requested by the Director.
* Independently develop and create reports for the Director. Such work may include but is not limited to staff related reports.

new_jobs.title: Events Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**STARR Restaurants** is seeking an ambitious, organized, and hospitality\-minded **Events Coordinator** to join our amazing team in New York City. This position is largely remote, but requires flexibility to meet onsite as business demands.


Working closely with our Senior Director of Events and Event Sales Managers, this position provides hands\-on administrative and coordination support for a diverse portfolio of affiliated STARR Restaurants, including:


Buddakan NY \| Pastis NY \| Le Café Louis Vuitton \| Le Coucou \| Babbo \| The Clocktower \| Electric Lemon \| El Vez \| Upland


We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership. For the right candidate, this is more than a coordinator position — it is an opportunity to learn from experienced event professionals, demonstrate your capabilities, and grow into greater responsibility within the organization.

 **This position offers a comprehensive package including:**

* Base Salary Range of $70,000–$80,000
* Paid Vacation and Sick Time
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits Coverage
* Referral Bonus Programs
* Dining Discounts at 25\+ affiliated STARR Restaurants

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support Event Sales Managers with day\-to\-day event sales and administrative needs.
* Respond to and qualify incoming event inquiries, including checking availability, suggesting alternative dates, and cross\-selling affiliated STARR Restaurant venues.
* Maintain accurate event bookings and availability across reservation and event\-management platforms.
* Maintain **Tripleseat**, including event details, menus, beverage selections, and picklists.
* Prepare and distribute weekly BEO packets and daily final BEOs to Restaurant Managers, Chefs, and relevant hospitality partners.
* Cross\-check BEOs against reservation platforms to ensure accuracy of dates, times, and event details.
* Communicate with Restaurant Managers, Chefs, Beverage Managers, and other internal teams regarding event availability, approvals, menus, and operational details.
* Maintain and update event menus in collaboration with Chefs and Event Sales Managers.
* Create customized event menus and collateral using **Adobe InDesign**.
* Assist with vendor coordination, including Certificates of Insurance, security requirements, and load\-in logistics.
* Assist with party rental orders and other event\-related logistics.
* Support Event Sales initiatives including competitive analysis, marketing projects, and departmental special projects.
* Provide additional support to the Events team as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* **2–3\+ years of experience** in event sales, event coordination, hospitality, restaurants, hotels, catering, or a related field.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong follow\-through and the ability to anticipate needs.
* Professional and confident when communicating with management, culinary teams, vendors, and clients.
* Experience with **Tripleseat** or another event\-management/CRM platform preferred.
* Experience with **OpenTable, Resy**, or other restaurant reservation platforms.
* Working knowledge of **Adobe InDesign**; experience creating menus or event collateral strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office and Google Workspace**.
* Hospitality\-minded with a polished, professional, and service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple restaurants and departments.

*Equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

Administrative Coordinator (aHEO) \- Human Resources


**POSITION DETAILS**


Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Administrative Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for the Office of Human Resources The position is responsible for ensuring professional front desk operations while managing administrative office functions, coordinating office operations, supporting budget and purchasing activities, and providing administrative support to the Director of Operations and the Human Resources Office. The position coordinates departmental activities, supports special projects and operational initiatives, and helps ensure the efficient delivery of HR services to the College community.


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the Office of Human Resources by greeting visitors, answering, screening, and directing telephone calls, and responding to general inquiries from employees, applicants, retirees, and members of the College community.
* Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative operations of the Human Resources Office, including office workflow, supply and inventory needs, purchasing activities, service requests, records, and general administrative support.
* Receive, review, and route HR documents, employment applications, and correspondence to the appropriate Human Resources staff.
* Provide administrative support to the Director of Operations, including coordinating calendars, scheduling meetings, preparing correspondence, reports, presentations, and other administrative materials.
* Provide administrative support to the Talent Acquisition and Engagement team by assisting with recruitment activities, interview scheduling, onboarding, employee engagement initiatives, and other hiring\-related functions.
* Assist with departmental projects, operational initiatives, and administrative activities across multiple Human Resources functions.
* Order office supplies, monitor inventory, process purchasing and vendor requests, and assist with budget tracking, invoice processing, and other administrative and fiscal activities.
* Maintain confidential departmental records, files, and documentation in accordance with College and University policies.
* Prepare reports, maintain spreadsheets, track assignments, and assist with data collection and analysis using Microsoft Office and University systems.
* Collaborate with Human Resources staff to support departmental operations and perform related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor’s degree required.


Preferred Qualifications:


* Experience providing administrative support in a Human Resources, higher education, or other professional office environment.
* Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint); experience with HRIS or ERP systems (e.g., CUNYfirst or Workday) is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.

Supports projects, initiatives, and activities that impact an academic or administrative department.


* Manages basic office functions such as communications, meeting schedules, work plans, staff assignments, and distributing information.
* Collects data for, prepares, and distributes reports and presentations using word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
* Updates office databases, lists, and files to ensure completeness and accuracy; maintains current information on department web site(s); maintains department archives and collections.
* Conducts internet and/or database research and performs basic systems queries to locate information related to department activities.
* Maintains department fiscal plans and budgets; assists in budget administration and invoice processing.
* Provides basic information, instructions, and materials as requested by students, faculty, and others who contact the department.
* May supervise office staff and student workers.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

* Sales experience in either the tile and stone industry, builder industry, or design industry
* Ability to lift up to 65 lbs.
* Friendly and outgoing personality
* Positive attitude, highly motivated and personable
* Team player who enjoys a challenge
* Ability to interact with people on all levels, ensuring that all external and internal communication is carried out to a high standard
* An independent problem solver, resourceful and collaborative
* Well organized with the ability to be flexible based on the needs of the business
* Must be a critical thinker and clear communicator

* Flexibility, self\-motivation, and drive to meet and exceed sales goals

new_jobs.description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.


At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **Account Manager – Biopharm** \- responsibility is to drive overall customer success aligned to the Cytiva strategy and goals leveraging all the Cytiva account team. Owns the overall customer relationship across the account. Primary contact between the company and customers and grows the business through an understanding of the market, an awareness and familiarity with the needs of customers, and knowledge of the product portfolio.


This position reports to the ***USCAN Biopharm Leader Mid\-Atlantic*** and is part of the BioProcessing OPCO, Job family \- Sales \> Account / Direct Sales


Working remotely to cover New Jersey based territory*.*

**What you will do:**

* Represent Cytiva and function as a primary customer point of contact in all allocated accounts and in the territory for Biopharm customer segments.
* Expand the business, gain market share, and grow sales \& order at expected margins. Achieve annual/quarterly targets through successful promotion of all business technologies and capabilities within all modalities which are relevant to this account.
* Provide technical support, leveraging technical specialists where needed, aligned with customer workflows and activities to develop and support solutions that meet or exceed the customers’ expectations.
* Identify opportunities and support team in developing opportunities.
* Develop and maintain a full understanding of the Cytiva value proposition and a high\-level knowledge of competitive products and services
* Prospecting, forecasting, generating proposals, preparing sales quotations, initiating, and planning customer visits at all levels of the customer organization
* Negotiating master agreements and contracts, including terms and conditions as well as facilitating tender responses to customers from the account, in conjunction with product sales specialists as needed.
* Accountable for overall account success and growth, leveraging Cytiva customer account team.
* Accountable to drive overall design\-in account strategies, aligned with Sales Specialists on technical Design in projects.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences or relevant field.
* 5 years commercial experience, preferably in the Biotechnology industry.
* Sales techniques include cross selling, upselling, value positions and funnel management.
* Business market knowledge.
* Ability to translate technical advantages into business benefits.
* Systems and Tools: QlikSense or Sales Force

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record**

* *Ability to travel – 50% travel, occasional overnight, within MD territory and Cytiva office/manufacturing locations.*
* *Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record*


Cytiva, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


At Cytiva we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cytiva can provide.


The annual salary range for this role is **$92,500 \- $162,000**. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.


This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

**50%** of annual base salary, Individual Target


We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
* Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
* Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go\-to\-market teams.

  

Cross\-functional collaboration* Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
* Work with marketing to develop analyst\-specific content programs, agency co\-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid\-market ERP ecosystem.
* Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst\-generated content and recommendations.

* Familiarity with the mid\-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.
* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long\-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.

**Inside Sales \& Account Development Representative**  
**Location:** Wall Street, New York City  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, In\-Office

Ideal Promotions is a growing promotional products and branded merchandise company working with businesses, schools, agencies, and organizations across the country.

We're looking for a motivated, organized, and personable **Inside Sales \& Account Development Representative** to join our team in our Wall Street office.

This is not a traditional cold\-calling position. We're looking for someone who can help take sales opportunities from initial interest through the majority of the sales process, keeping customers engaged, organized, and moving toward a purchase. You'll work closely with our sales team, helping turn opportunities into orders and handing off larger deals when they're ready to close.

**What You'll Do**

* Communicate with prospective and existing customers by phone and email
* Learn what customers are looking for, including their budget, quantity, event date, audience, and goals
* Help source products and put together creative merchandise recommendations
* Prepare quotes, presentations, and customer proposals
* Follow up on open quotes, samples, artwork, and active opportunities
* Keep customers engaged and consistently move opportunities toward the next step
* Reactivate previous customers and identify new opportunities within existing accounts
* Coordinate internally with sales, design, vendors, and operations
* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in our CRM
* Assist the sales team with day\-to\-day projects and priorities
* Take ownership of smaller opportunities from start to finish as you become comfortable in the role

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3\+ years of experience in inside sales, account management, sales support, customer success, business development, or another customer\-facing role
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple opportunities at once
* Confident speaking with customers on the phone
* Strong follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting to be told the next step
* Able to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment where everyone helps where needed
* Comfortable learning new software, CRM systems, and sales tools
* A positive, motivated attitude with a genuine interest in sales and business development

Experience in promotional products, marketing, advertising, events, apparel, printing, corporate gifting, or another B2B industry is a plus, but **not required**.

**Growth Opportunity**

We want this person to grow with the company. As you learn our business and prove yourself, you'll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, manage your own accounts, earn performance\-based compensation/commission, and grow into a larger sales or account management role.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Vascular Services
new_jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative \- Vascular Services  
Employment Type: Full\-Time  
Location: New York City, NY  
Travel: Local travel required throughout the territory  
Reports To: VP of Operations  


Position Summary  


We are seeking a motivated and personable Business Development Representative to develop new business relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living communities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare facilities.  


The primary responsibility of this position is to identify facilities that could benefit from our vascular services, establish relationships with administrators and healthcare decision\-makers, educate them about our services, and develop referral partnerships that generate new business.  


This is a relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position for someone who enjoys meeting people, making connections, and developing long\-term business relationships in the healthcare community.  


Key Responsibilities  


Identify and develop relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare organizations.  
Research and identify potential facilities that have a need for vascular services.  
Contact facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Medical Directors, case managers, discharge planners, and other appropriate decision\-makers.  
Attend Quality meetings at facilities  
Schedule and conduct in\-person visits and presentations with facility leadership and healthcare staff.  
Explain our vascular services and how we can support their residents and patients.  
Develop referral relationships and establish our company as a trusted vascular\-service provider.  
Follow up consistently with prospective and existing facility partners.  
Maintain a pipeline of prospective facilities and track contacts, meetings, referrals, and business opportunities.  
Work closely with our clinical and operations teams to ensure a smooth transition from referral to patient care.  
Attend healthcare networking events, industry meetings, and community events to develop new relationships.  
Identify opportunities to expand services within existing facility relationships.  
Maintain accurate records of business\-development activities and report progress to management.  
Meet established goals for facility outreach, meetings, new relationships, and referrals.  


Ideal Candidate  


The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated, outgoing, and persistent relationship builder who is comfortable approaching healthcare organizations and developing business from the ground up.  


Experience in healthcare sales or business development is preferred, particularly experience working with:  


Nursing homes  
Skilled nursing facilities  
Assisted\-living facilities  
Home health agencies  
Hospice organizations  
Hospitals  
Rehabilitation facilities  
Physician practices  
Long\-term care organizations  


Candidates with strong sales, networking, marketing, or healthcare relationship\-building experience will also be considered.  


Qualifications  


Previous experience in business development, sales, healthcare marketing, or account management preferred.  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Comfortable making cold calls and conducting face\-to\-face meetings.  
Professional and confident when speaking with healthcare administrators and clinical leadership.  
Highly organized and able to manage multiple prospects and relationships.  
Self\-directed and able to work independently.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to healthcare facilities.  
Ability to build trust and maintain long\-term professional relationships.  
Familiarity with the long\-term\-care and senior\-care healthcare environment is a plus.  


Performance Expectations  


Success in this position will be measured by activities and results such as:  


Number of qualified facilities identified.  
Facility visits and decision\-maker meetings.  
New facility relationships established.  
New referral partnerships developed.  
Referral volume generated.  
Growth of business within existing facility accounts.  
Consistent follow\-up and maintenance of the sales pipeline.  


Compensation:  


We are open to structuring compensation with a base salary or hourly rate plus performance\-based incentives tied to successful business development and new facility relationships.  


Why Join Us?  


This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding access to vascular services for residents and patients in long\-term\-care and assisted\-living communities.  


The successful candidate will have the opportunity to build a healthcare referral network, develop meaningful professional relationships, and directly contribute to the growth of the organization.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
The Hamlin Group is adding an Operations Coordinator to create operational leverage across the business — taking ownership of the administrative, coordination, and follow\-through work that currently pulls leadership away from design, sales, and high\-value client decisions.


You will work alongside company leadership and the Design \& Selections Coordinator, managing the day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep a luxury residential remodeling firm running. This is a developmental role. You will start by learning our systems, our standards, and how we operate. Over time, as you develop confidence and capability, you will take on more ownership and responsibility. What we are looking for is not someone who has done all of this before — we are looking for someone with a solid foundation, a sharp mind, and the drive to build the rest with our guidance.


We are a small company that operates at a standard most firms twice our size don't reach. That means every person on this team matters, dependability is a requirement, and when you say you have something, you see it through.

**Work Environment**

* On\-site — Chamblee, GA office
* Monday through Friday, standard business hours
* Occasional local errands or permit office visits as needed
* Professional, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture

**The Right Person**


We are looking for someone who operates a certain way — not just someone who checks the right boxes on a resume.


You notice what others miss. You finish what you start. You create order out of ambiguity and don't require repeated reminders. You ask good questions, document the answers, and don't need to be taught the same thing twice. When something is off track, you communicate early. When a problem lands in front of you, your instinct is to solve it — not just report it. You can manage multiple workstreams without losing details, and you take pride in the fact that things run better because you are in the room.

 **Compensation:**
$65,000

 **Responsibilities:*** **Lead Management \& Client Communication** — Serve as the first point of contact for incoming leads. Field calls and emails, hold initial conversations to understand the project and determine fit, and manage lead information in our project management system. You are the first professional voice a potential client hears.
* **Invoice \& Expense Processing** — Manage trade contractor invoice processing, expense coding, and payment tracking with guidance from the project team. You will learn how our project budgets work and grow into running this process independently.

new_jobs.title: Partnerships Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Remote role in the USA**

**Role Overview**

Uncapped lends working capital to e\-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.


We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.


You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.


This is a hands\-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

**About Uncapped**

Founded in 2019, **Uncapped** is a leading fintech provider of working \& growth capital to e\-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting\-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e\-commerce platforms — including **Amazon and Walmart** — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

**What will you do ✍️**

**1\. Recruitment: bring new partners in**


Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.

**2\. Activation: get them to a first funded deal**


Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.

**3\. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed**


The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co\-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.

**4\. The long tail: run it as a program**


Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always\-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self\-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.

**5\. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number**


Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.

**6\. Partner economics and commission**


Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.

**7\. Reporting and forecasting**


Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and originations, measured against plan. You will be the person who explains the number each week, including in the weeks it is bad.

 **Requirements** **Who you are**

**Must have**

* 3\+ years in partnerships, channel sales, or a similar commercial role. Lending, fintech, payments or e\-commerce SaaS is useful background but not essential
* A track record of building pipeline from scratch and converting it, whether that was partners, direct sales or something else
* Comfort owning a revenue number and reporting against a plan
* Working knowledge of a GTM stack. A CRM plus at least one of a PRM, a sequencing tool or a lifecycle marketing platform. You should be happy setting things up yourself rather than raising a request for it

**Nice to have**

* PartnerStack, HubSpot, Clay, Instantly, HeyReach or Customer.io specifically
* SQL, or a habit of building your own reporting rather than waiting for it
* Having worked on building a channel, rather than inheriting one that already ran

 **Benefits**  

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start\-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

* Competitive base \+ uncapped commission — top performers earn meaningfully
* Unlimited holiday — well\-rested people make the best closers
* MacBook
* Personal growth fund — raise your game from great to spectacular
* Monthly recognition and awards — celebrate wins big and small
* The opportunity to close deals every day with **US e\-commerce founders** building real businesses

**We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.**

new_jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
* Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
* Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go\-to\-market teams.

  

Cross\-functional collaboration* Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
* Work with marketing to develop analyst\-specific content programs, agency co\-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid\-market ERP ecosystem.
* Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst\-generated content and recommendations.

 **Qualifications**


Required* 10\+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.
* Familiarity with the mid\-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.
* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long\-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.
* Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pi

**SOVOS**


**Business Development Representative**
=======================================


Sovos·Full\-Time·United States


**Build Your Future With Us**


The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real\-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI\-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real\-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.


We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.


AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.


Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
**THE ROLE**


At Sovos, we're looking for a motivated Business Development Representative to help us connect businesses with the compliance solutions they need to thrive. In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for potential clients, sparking interest through targeted outreach, relationship\-building, and genuine curiosity about how we can help them solve real challenges. Your work will directly fuel our sales pipeline and open doors to new opportunities across the market.


*More specifically, you will:*


* Generate qualified sales meetings by identifying and engaging potential business prospects through networking, outreach, and strategic follow\-up on marketing campaigns.
* Partner with Sales Executives to develop and execute territory plans that align with revenue and pipeline creation targets.
* Leverage AI tools and structured outreach processes to manage multiple sales opportunities simultaneously and build a strong, active pipeline.
* Independently introduce and promote Sovos' solutions to customers and prospects, demonstrating discretion and sound judgment in every interaction.
* Develop and deliver regular forecasts of revenue goals and outreach objectives, contributing to the team's achievement of broader business targets.
* Identify and implement enhancements to outreach strategies, processes, tools, and materials to benefit both internal teams and external prospects.
**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**


* You're ready to build a career in business development, with strong communication skills and a track record of meeting goals — whether in sales, customer service, or another client\-facing role.
* You engage effectively with mid\-level and executive contacts, adapting quickly in conversations and maintaining a professional, positive demeanor.
* You're comfortable with AI\-assisted workflows and proficient with contact management solutions (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office tools.
* You bring strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to present confidently to small or large groups.
* You're a creative problem\-solver with strong planning, organization, and prioritization abilities, and you're proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check and drug test upon hire.
**THE PROCESS**


We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:


**1**
**Pre\-Employment Assessment**


Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.


**2**
**Video Interview**


A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.


**3**
**Meeting with a Recruiter**


A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.


**4**
**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**


Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day\-to\-day of the role.


**LIFE AT SOVOS**


The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!


* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Flexible Time\-Off
* Comprehensive Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* HSA with Sovos match
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Volunteer Time Off and Charitable Giving Match
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.


**Company Background**
----------------------


Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150\+ countries.
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more

If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.  



ARCO/Murray National Construction is currently looking for a detail\-oriented, self\-reliant Project Coordinator to join our team. At ARCO, you'll have the opportunity to improve project performance, set up processes and drive your own success from day one!  


**A Day in the Life:*** Typing/preparing various items such as letters, bid instructions, meeting minutes, weekly updates, memos, proposals, outline specifications, timesheets, and expense reports
* Assist Project Managers with Proposals by typing up proposal letters, outline specifications, manage the work/design schedule and assemble proposal books in a timely manner as per Project Manager
* Maintain various lists for Project Managers including job list for each region, subcontract tracking list, filing and vacation lists
* Prepare various forms as directed by Projects Managers (Subcontracts, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, AGC Agreements, Professional Service Agreements, and transmittals)
* Point person for proposal and capabilities packages. This includes putting together proposal covers, tabs, company information, sell sheets and then assembling once provided with rest of the materials by Project Manager
* Preparation for meetings and trainings including scheduling, preparing handouts, and coordinating lunches
* Book all travel when necessary
* Answer incoming phone calls and coordinate communication with vendors and customers in the event of a Project Manager's absence
* Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

  


**Necessary Qualifications:*** 3\-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus
* Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Must be extremely organized, self\-reliant, proactive, and detail\-oriented

  


**What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.


* Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Traditional and Roth 401k
* Tuition reimbursement for associates
* Scholarship for associates' children up to $28,000 per child
* 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
* 1\-week paid volunteer leave each year
* 100% charitable match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* Paid parental leave


Typical base compensation for the Project Coordinator role is between $60,000 and $80,000\. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company.  



At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.



From recruiting, training, and hiring practices to selecting our subcontractors, we understand that diversity of all those involved in the construction process enhances our ability to deliver the best solutions to our customers. We hire the best and the brightest from across the country – constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.

  


*\#LI\-AM2 \#LI\-Onsite***MAKE YOUR MOVE**



We are proud to be one of the fastest\-growing, privately\-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design\-build experts. We have completed over 7,500 design\-build projects nationwide. We ranked \#9 on ENR's Design\-Build Firms list and \#34 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2026\. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us, and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person who can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is "Yes!" we look forward to meeting you.


*ARCO does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies without pre\-approval from ARCO's Human Resources team. Pre\-approval is required before any external candidate can be submitted. Agencies must have a fully executed vendor agreement in place as well as written approval to submit candidates from an ARCO TA Manager for a specific position before submitting candidates.*

You'll support engineering teams by managing documentation and coordinating communication between internal engineers, clients, contractors, and vendors, ensuring projects stay on track, within scope, and within budget. This is a great fit for someone who wants hands\-on exposure to coordinate MEP/electrical engineering projects run from kickoff to closeout.

 **What You'll Do**

* Build a centralized documentation and tracking system across your assigned electrical projects, so meeting notes, RFIs, closeout files, and vendor submittals are logged in a consistent, searchable format within 48 hours of receipt.
* Screen incoming vendor product data and technical submittals against project specifications, catching missing information and formatting issues before they reach engineers and cutting down on submittals returned as incomplete.
* Track schedules and milestones across a portfolio of concurrent projects, and flag any timeline variance to the project manager within 24 hours instead of holding it for the next status meeting.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for routine client and contractor communications, resolving non\-technical questions yourself and routing technical ones to the right engineer without delay.
* Set up coordination meetings, help set up project timelines, join internal and client\-facing calls, capture accurate notes and action items, and follow up until every item is closed.
* Build working proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD within your first six months, opening project models on your own, pulling the views engineers request, and flagging obvious clashes or omissions ahead of coordination meetings.
* Reprioritize daily across competing deadlines as urgent vendor issues and client requests come up.

 **You'd Be a Strong Fit If**

* You have a PMP certification (strongly preferred)
* You have early\-career experience in project coordination, administration, or a related support role, ideally at an architecture, engineering, or MEP firm, and you're the person your team relies on to know where every document and deadline stands.
* You have coordinated projects in construction, engineering, or a related technical field.
* You can keep several projects moving at once and still notice when a date or a missing spec sheet is about to become a problem.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, clients, and contractors, and you know which questions are yours to answer and which belong with an engineer.
* You're curious about BIM and want regular, hands\-on time in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD, even if you're still building that skill set.

 **Why VIATechnik**


This role places you at the center of multiple active electrical construction projects, with regular exposure to new clients, contractors, and technical challenges. You'll work directly in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD models as part of your everyday work, and as your fluency grows, so does your ownership over vendor documentation, scheduling, and the projects you support. The role is built as a direct path into project management or BIM and VDC coordination.


The pace is fast and decision\-making can be informal. Engineers count on the coordinator to catch problems before they escalate. People who do well here enjoy bringing order to moving parts and stay steady when the plan changes.

  



**Win\-Win Statement**


VIATechnik needs someone who will take ownership of the documentation, scheduling, and communication that keeps electrical projects moving, freeing engineers to focus on design and technical coordination. In return, you get a direct path toward project management or BIM coordination, hands\-on exposure to the tools and projects that make that path real, and a role where your organization and follow\-through are visible in every project's outcome. This is a genuine trade: your reliability for our investment in your growth.

 **Compensation and featured benefits:**

* The pay for this position is **$75,000– $100,000**, and the role is eligible for bonuses. The actual salary offer may be different as we carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, location, and experience
* Health insurance with the choice of five plan options. We cover 70\-95% of premiums for VIATechies and 65% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plan chosen)
* Dental and vision insurance. We cover up to 75% of the monthly insurance premiums for VIATechies and up to 50% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plans chosen)
* Open and flexible time off
* A 401(k) plan that is fully vested immediately
* Home office setup costs
* Paid holidays

Our technology reasons through a patient's entire medical record to recommend diagnoses that would otherwise be missed, in real time at the point of care, during chart review, and in population\-wide screening to identify patients who qualify for lifesaving treatment.

  

We work alongside some of the top health systems in the country to lead the change this industry needs. We're excited by challenges, mission\-oriented work, and meaningful relationships. We want you to join us.
